Android.name: Dynamic Application Finder
Android.description: Artifacts found using the Dynamic Application Finder vary depending on your case's evidence. To learn more, see Processing details > Find more artifacts in the AXIOM User Guide.

Android.name: Activity Manager History
Android.description: Activity Manager History contains a list of recent activity manager events, identified by the package name that triggered the event.

Android.name: Android Application Roles
Android.description: Android Application Roles contains a list of the default set application for specific functions in Android.

Android.name: Android Device Information
Android.description: Android Device Information contains the phone identification values.

Android.name: Android Usage History
Android.description: Android Usage History contains information about the usage and activity of applications that are running on the device.

Android.name: Android Usage History (Dumpsys)
Android.description: Android Usage History (Dumpsys) contains information about the usage and activity of applications running on the device, recovered using the dumpsys utility. The dates and times that were recovered by this artifact reflect the local time of the device.

Android.name: Android User Dictionary
Android.description: Contains the shortcuts and words the user has on his or her device.

Android.name: Application Activity - Android
Android.description: Application Activity represents the applications that are active in the background of the operating system.

Android.name: Application Permissions - Android
Android.description: Application Permissions contains information about the application permissions that a user has granted or declined.

Android.name: Application Power Usage
Android.description: Application Power Usage represents the amount of battery power consumed by each application since the device's last full charge.

Android.name: Application Runtime Permissions
Android.description: Application Runtime Permissions contains information about the application permissions that a user has granted or declined while the application is running.

Android.name: Device Health Services Application Usage
Android.description: Device Health Services Application Usage provides information about the applications that were used on the device, including each time the same application was used, within a recorded interval.

Android.name: Device Health Services Battery Usage
Android.description: Device Health Services Battery Usage provides information about when the user was charging their device and what the battery level percentage was at that time. This artifact also includes the timezone that the device was set to at that time.

Android.name: Device Reset/Activation Times
Android.description: Device Reset/Activation Times contains the approximate reset or wipe and activation date times on a device. It's extremely important to compare this data to other data on the device. For more information: https://thebinaryhick.blog/2021/08/19/wipeout-detecting-android-factory-resets/.

Android.name: Digital Wellbeing Events
Android.description: Digital Wellbeing Events contains information about events that are tracked by the Digital Wellbeing app. Events describe state changes such as when an application pauses or resumes. Digital Wellbeing is a system application that's available on most Android 9 and 10 devices. The app is used to track events and provide the user with options to limit their usage of applications and set up a sleep schedule to reduce device usage.

Android.name: Digital Wellbeing Limits
Android.description: Digital Wellbeing Limits is used for restricting the amount of time for application usage. An application is suspended once the time limit has been reached.

Android.name: Google Play Application Details
Android.description: Google Play Application Details contains more detailed information about the applications that a user has downloaded from Google Play. This information includes when the user last installed or updated an application, and how the user was referred to the application.

Android.name: Google Play Installed Applications
Android.description: Google Play Installed Applications lists each of the applications that were downloaded and installed from Google Play.

Android.name: Google Play Searches
Android.description: Google Play Searches contains the search queries that a user has performed in Google Play, and the date and time of when they were performed.

Android.name: Installed Applications
Android.description: Installed Applications contains a list of all of the applications on an Android device, including their versions.

Android.name: Privacy Dashboard
Android.description: Privacy Dashboard is an Android system application that displays 24 hours of permission access by device applications for the user to see.

Android.name: Samsung Customization Service Analyzed Places
Android.description: The Samsung Customization Service Analyzed Places artifact contains information about locations associated with various monitored events. The Customization Service may use instrumentation and sensors in conjunction with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to predict the device location for the monitored event.

Android.name: Samsung Customization Service Application Usage
Android.description: The Samsung Customization Service Application Usage artifact contains information about the applications that were used on the device.

Android.name: Samsung Customization Service Charging Connections
Android.description: The Samsung Customization Service Charging Connections artifact contains information about various types of charging connections made at specific timestamps.

Android.name: Samsung Customization Service Location Logs
Android.description: The Samsung Customization Service Location Logs artifact contains user geolocation data, timestamps, and location providers.

Android.name: Samsung Customization Service Motion Logs
Android.description: The Samsung Customization Service Motion Logs artifact contains information about various types of motions made at specific timestamps.

Android.name: Samsung Customization Service Web Activity
Android.description: The Samsung Customization Service Web Activity artifact contains information about web pages that were visited using the Samsung Internet Browser.

Android.name: Samsung Device Health Services Battery Statistics
Android.description: Samsung Device Health Services Battery Statistics provides information about the applications that were used on the device, including each time the same application was used, within a recorded interval. This artifact also contains details about how the user used the applications, and for how long.

Android.name: Samsung Device Health Services CPU Data
Android.description: Samsung Device Health Services CPU Data provides information about the processes that were running on the device, including each time period a process was running. This artifact also contains details about how much CPU usage a process had.

Android.name: Samsung Device Health Services Network Statistics
Android.description: Samsung Device Health Services Network Statistics provides information about the applications or services that were using the network on the device, including the time period when each application or service was running. This artifact also contains details about how much data the application or service used on the network.

Android.name: Samsung Digital Wellbeing Events
Android.description: Samsung Digital Wellbeing Events contains information about events that are tracked by the Samsung Digital Wellbeing app. Events describe state changes such as when an application pauses or resumes. Samsung Digital Wellbeing is a system application that's available only on Samsung devices and replaces the native Android Digital Wellbeing app. The app is used to track events and provide the user with options to limit their usage of applications and set up a sleep schedule to reduce device usage.

Android.name: Samsung Digital Wellbeing Limits
Android.description: Samsung Digital Wellbeing Limits is used for restricting the amount of time for application usage. An application is suspended once the time limit has been reached.

Android.name: Samsung Places
Android.description: The Samsung Places artifact contains information related to user configured Samsung locations and their associated geolocation, WiFi, and Bluetooth connection information.

Android.name: Android Dropbox
Android.description: Android Dropbox contains Dropbox file information recovered from a Kindle device.

Android.name: Android Dropbox Account Info
Android.description: Android Dropbox Account Info contains Dropbox account information recovered from a Kindle device.

Android.name: MEGA Accounts
Android.description: MEGA Accounts contains information about the accounts that the local user has logged in with on the device.

Android.name: MEGA Chat
Android.description: MEGA Chat contains messages sent and received by the local user.

Android.name: MEGA Contacts
Android.description: MEGA Contacts contains information about MEGA users that have communicated with the local user account.

Android.name: AIM Buddies
Android.description: Contains the AIM buddies that were recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: AIM Messages
Android.description: Contains the AIM messages that were recovered from and Android device.

Android.name: Android Blocked Phone Numbers
Android.description: Android Blocked Phone Numbers contains the list of blocked phone numbers from a recovered Android device.

Android.name: Android Burner Conversations
Android.description: Android Burner Conversations contains the Burner conversations that were recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: Android Burner Numbers
Android.description: Android Burner Numbers contains the Burner numbers that were recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: Android Call Logs
Android.description: Android Call Logs contains information about the phone calls that occur using the Android Phone application.

Android.name: Android Call Logs (UFED Agent)
Android.description: Android Call Logs (UFED Agent) contains calling logs from the Phone application on Android. These logs are recovered from <incoming_calls>, <outgoing_calls>, <missed_calls>, <unknown_calls> tags found in a UFED Report.xml.

Android.name: Android Contacts
Android.description: Android Contacts contains contact information from a recovered Android device.

Android.name: Android Contacts (UFED Agent)
Android.description: Android Contacts (UFED Agent) contains information recovered from the Contacts application on Android. These contacts are recovered from <contacts> tag found in a UFED Report.xml.

Android.name: Android Facebook Messenger Attachments
Android.description: Android Facebook Messenger Attachments contains information about files shared within Facebook Messenger. Picture and video files are valuable when investigating the device for illicit content. Media content can help an examiner identify victims in cases of child abuse material and exploitation. In a corporate environment, pictures can contain scans of confidential documents, easily shared through file sharing.

Android.name: Android Google Hangouts Messages
Android.description: Android Google Hangouts Messages contains the messages from Google Hangouts from an Android device.

Android.name: Android Kik Messenger Attachments
Android.description: Android Kik Messenger Attachments contains the attachments of messages from Kik Messenger from an Android device.

Android.name: Android Kik Messenger Contacts
Android.description: Android Kik Messenger Contacts contains information about a user's Kik Messenger contacts.

Android.name: Android Kik Messenger Messages
Android.description: Android Kik Messenger Messages contains Kik Messenger messages that were sent or received by the local user.

Android.name: Android Messages
Android.description: SMS/MMS messages sent and received using Android Messages.

Android.name: Android MMS
Android.description: MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. These messages are recovered from mmssms.db.

Android.name: Android MMS (UFED Agent)
Android.description: Android MMS (UFED Agent) contains MMS messages sent or received using the Messages app on Android. These messages are recovered from <mms_messages> tags found in a UFED Report.xml

Android.name: Android Sim Card Information
Android.description: Android SIM Card Information is information about the device's SIM card that is recoverable if the user has the Android Messages application installed on the device.

Android.name: Android SMS
Android.description: SMS messages sent using the Messages app on Android.

Android.name: Android SMS (UFED Agent)
Android.description: Android SMS (UFED Agent) contains SMS messages sent or received using the Messages app on Android. These messages are recovered from <sms_messages> tags found in a UFED Report.xml.

Android.name: Android SMS/MMS
Android.description: SMS and MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. These messages are recovered from mmssms.db.

Android.name: Android SMS/MMS (Content Provider)
Android.description: SMS/MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. Data for this artifact is recovered during the acquisition process using an Android Content Provider.

Android.name: Android SMS/MMS (Google Play Services)
Android.description: SMS and MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. These messages are recovered from icing_mmssms.db.

Android.name: Android TextNow Calls
Android.description: Android TextNow Calls contains information about calls and voicemails that are sent and received through the TextNow application.

Android.name: Android TextNow Chat
Android.description: Android TextNow Chat contains chat messages that are sent and received through the TextNow application.

Android.name: Android TextNow Contacts
Android.description: Android TextNow Contacts contains the application, phone, email and group contacts that a user has in the TextNow application.

Android.name: Android TextNow Groups
Android.description: Android TextNow Groups contains membership information for TextNow group chats.

Android.name: Android TextNow Profile
Android.description: Android TextNow Profile contains TextNow user profiles and application preference settings.

Android.name: Android TigerText Messages
Android.description: Android TigerText Messages contains messages from the TigerText Android application.

Android.name: BlackBerry Messenger Contacts
Android.description: Contains the BBM Contacts recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: BlackBerry Messenger File Transfers
Android.description: Contains the BBM File Transfers recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: BlackBerry Messenger Invitations
Android.description: BlackBerry Messenger Invitations contains BBM invite requests recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: BlackBerry Messenger Locations
Android.description: BlackBerry Messenger Locations contains BBM locations recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: BlackBerry Messenger Messages
Android.description: Contains the BBM messages recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: BlackBerry Messenger Profile
Android.description: Contains the BBM Profiles recovered from an Android device.

Android.name: Burner Contacts
Android.description: Burner Contacts contains information about a subject's Burner Contacts, as recovered from their Android device.

Android.name: Burner Messages
Android.description: Burner Messages contains information about messages and calls that are sent and received using Burner.

Android.name: Burner Numbers
Android.description: Burner Numbers contains information about the burner numbers that the local user created.

Android.name: Cake Local User Account
Android.description: Cake Local User Account contains information about the logged in local user.

Android.name: Cake Messages
Android.description: Cake Messages contains messages sent and received by the local user.

Android.name: Chatous Chat Messages
Android.description: Chatous Chat Messages contains messages that were sent and received using the Chatous application.

Android.name: Chatous Chat Partners
Android.description: Chatous Chat Partners contains information about the users that the local user has communicated with.

Android.name: Discord Channels
Android.description: Discord Channels contains information about each of the channels joined or hosted by the local user account.

Android.name: Discord Logged-in Account
Android.description: Discord Logged-in Account contains information about the user that is currently logged into Discord on the device. Information about other accounts that were previously logged into are not recoverable.

Android.name: Discord Messages
Android.description: Discord Messages contains information about messages and calls that are sent and received using Discord. Messages from some channels might be missing if they haven't been cached by the application. This artifact uses both parsing and carving techniques to recover messages.

Android.name: Discord Servers
Android.description: Discord Servers contains information about the servers which host Discord channels.

Android.name: Facebook Messenger Accounts
Android.description: Facebook Messenger Accounts contains information about the accounts accessed from the device using Facebook Messenger. Status and location updates in social media can provide detail on where the user has been.

Android.name: Facebook Messenger Calls
Android.description: Facebook Messenger Calls contains call data recovered from Facebook Messenger. Provides useful background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with. Status and location updates in social media can also provide location information about them.

Android.name: Facebook Messenger End-to-End Encrypted Chats
Android.description: Facebook Messenger End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) Chats contains messages recovered from Facebook Messenger E2EE chats on the device.

Android.name: Facebook Messenger Groups
Android.description: Facebook Messenger Groups contains data about group chats on Facebook Messenger. Provides useful background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with. Status and location updates in social media can also provide location information about them.

Android.name: Facebook Messenger Messages
Android.description: Facebook Messenger Messages contains messages recovered from Facebook Messenger. Provides useful background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with. Status and location updates in social media can also provide location information about them.

Android.name: Facebook Messenger Users Contacted
Android.description: Facebook Messenger Users Contacted contains information about users contacted from the device using Facebook Messenger. Status and location updates in social media can provide detail on where the user has been. In addition, this artifact provides background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with.

Android.name: Glide Messages
Android.description: Glide Messages contains messages sent and received by the local user.

Android.name: Glide Users
Android.description: Glide Users contains information about the contacts that the local user has added using Glide. The local user's contact information is also recovered by this artifact.

Android.name: Google Duo Activity
Android.description: Google Duo Activity contains details about audio calls, video calls, and messages sent and received by the user.

Android.name: Google Duo Group Calls
Android.description: Google Duo Group Calls contains details about the video calls made and received by the user.

Android.name: Google Duo Groups
Android.description: Google Duo Groups contains membership information of Google Duo Groups.

Android.name: Google Hangouts Cached Images
Android.description: Google Hangouts Cached Images contains the cached images from Google Hangouts from an Android device.

Android.name: Google Hangouts Voice Calls
Android.description: Google Hangouts Voice Calls contains a history of voice calls between the local user and other users.

Android.name: Google Meet Meeting History
Android.description: Google Meet Meeting History contains the meetings that any local user on the device has joined.

Android.name: GroupMe Accounts
Android.description: GroupMe Accounts contains information about the accounts that the local user has logged in with on the device.

Android.name: GroupMe Contacts
Android.description: GroupMe Contacts contains information about a user's contacts.

Android.name: GroupMe Groups
Android.description: GroupMe Groups contains information about the groups that the logged-in user is a member of.

Android.name: GroupMe Messages
Android.description: GroupMe Messages contains the messages sent and received using GroupMe.

Android.name: Gtalk Contacts
Android.description: Gtalk Contacts contains contact information that was recovered from Gtalk.

Android.name: Gtalk Messages
Android.description: Gtalk Message contains the details of messages that were recovered from Gtalk.

Android.name: Houseparty Messages
Android.description: Houseparty Messages contains messages recovered from Houseparty.

Android.name: Houseparty Users
Android.description: Houseparty Users contains information about the users that were contacted from the device using Houseparty.

Android.name: imo Contacts
Android.description: imo Contacts contains information about a user's contacts.

Android.name: imo Messages
Android.description: imo Messages contains information about sent and received messages and calls made using the imo application.

Android.name: IP Addresses - Audio/Video Calls
Android.description: IP Addresses of web audio/video calls show who a user was communicating with. Each instance of this artifact represents a single hop in the communication chain. By showing the relationship between multiple hops, you can determine where a call originated from and what the final destination was.

Android.name: Jott Groups
Android.description: Jott Groups contains information about the groups that the Jott user is a member of.

Android.name: Jott Messages
Android.description: Jott Messages contains information about the messages sent or received by the Jott user.

Android.name: KakaoTalk Browsing History
Android.description: KakaoTalk Browsing History contains the web browsing history on any links visited within the KakaoTalk application.

Android.name: KakaoTalk Calls
Android.description: KakaoTalk Calls contains audio calls and/or video calls sent or received using KakaoTalk.

Android.name: KakaoTalk Chat Rooms
Android.description: KakaoTalk Chat Rooms contains KakaoTalk chat rooms that the user participates in.

Android.name: KakaoTalk Detected Wifi
Android.description: KakaoTalk Detected Wifi contains the network name of any WiFi networks detected by KakaoTalk.

Android.name: KakaoTalk Friends
Android.description: KakaoTalk Friends contains the user's KakaoTalk friends and contacts.

Android.name: KakaoTalk Messages
Android.description: KakaoTalk Messages contains messages sent or received using KakaoTalk.

Android.name: LINE Chats
Android.description: LINE Chats contains the chats that the local user is a part of.

Android.name: LINE Contacts
Android.description: LINE Contacts contains the user's LINE contacts.

Android.name: LINE Groups
Android.description: LINE Groups contains the information from the groups that the local user is a part of.

Android.name: LINE Messages
Android.description: LINE Messages contains messages that were sent and received through LINE on Android.

Android.name: LINE Pictures
Android.description: LINE Pictures contains pictures originating from LINE.

Android.name: Mail.Ru Agent Contacts
Android.description: Mail.Ru Agent Contacts contains contact info for the Agent application on Android.

Android.name: Mail.Ru Agent Messages
Android.description: Mail.Ru Agent Messages contains messages sent or received by the Agent user on Android.

Android.name: Mail.Ru Agent User Accounts
Android.description: Mail.Ru Agent User Accounts contains information about the Agent user accounts that are saved locally on the Android device.

Android.name: Microsoft Teams Activity
Android.description: Microsoft Teams Activity contains interactions that occur between users on Microsoft Teams. These interactions include messages, members added/removed from meetings, and meeting start/end events.

Android.name: Microsoft Teams Calendar
Android.description: Microsoft Teams Calendar contains a record of all upcoming and past calendar events that use Microsoft Teams. Offline meetings are not included.

Android.name: Microsoft Teams Calls
Android.description: Microsoft Teams Calls contains call logs that occurred between users on Microsoft Teams. The Call ID can be used with Microsoft Teams Messages to view additional information about the call.

Android.name: Microsoft Teams Conversations
Android.description: Microsoft Teams Conversations contains a summary of the last message details (sender, time, and content) and registered participants in the local user's chat or meeting conversations on Microsoft Teams.

Android.name: Microsoft Teams Messages
Android.description: Microsoft Teams Messages contains interactions that occur between users on Microsoft Teams. These interactions include messages, meeting calls, members added/removed from meetings, and meeting start/end events. The Call ID can be used with Microsoft Teams Calls to view additional information about call events.

Android.name: ooVoo Chat History
Android.description: ooVoo Chat History contains the chat history between the data owner and their contacts.

Android.name: ooVoo Contact List
Android.description: ooVoo Contact List contains the list of contacts that the data owner has on ooVoo.

Android.name: ooVoo Phone Book
Android.description: ooVoo Phone Book contains the name and phone number of contacts from the data owner's iOS device.

Android.name: QQ File Transfers
Android.description: QQ File Transfers contains file transfers recovered from the QQ application.

Android.name: QQ Local Users
Android.description: QQ Local Users contains local users recovered from the QQ application.

Android.name: QQ Messages
Android.description: QQ Messages contains messages stored by the QQ application.

Android.name: Samsung Messages
Android.description: Samsung Messages is an application that is installed by default on Samsung Android devices and is used for sending SMS and MMS messages.

Android.name: Samsung Text Message Logs
Android.description: Text message logs recovered from a Samsung Android device.

Android.name: Session Communities
Android.description: Session Communities contains information about the open session groups that the local user has joined.

Android.name: Session Groups
Android.description: Session Groups specifies each of the Session groups that the local user is a member of.

Android.name: Session Messages
Android.description: Session Messages contains information about the messages and calls that are exchanged between the local user and other users on an Android device.

Android.name: Session Users
Android.description: Session Users contains information about the users the local user has associated with through communities, group chats, or direct messages.

Android.name: Signal Conversations - Android
Android.description: Signal Conversations contains information about the group or individual conversations that the local user has participated in.

Android.name: Signal Group Members
Android.description: Signal Group Members specifies the members from each of the Signal groups that the local user is a member of.

Android.name: Signal Groups
Android.description: Signal Groups contains information about the members of groups

Android.name: Signal Local User
Android.description: Signal Local User contains information about the local user account.

Android.name: Signal Messages - Android
Android.description: Signal Messages contains information about the messages and calls that are exchanged between the local user and other users.

Android.name: Signal Stories
Android.description: Signal Stories contains information about stories that are posted, viewed, or exchanged between the local user and other users on an Android device.

Android.name: Signal Users
Android.description: Signal Users lists all of the users and profiles present in the application.

Android.name: Skype Accounts
Android.description: Skype Accounts contains information about the Skype accounts that are recovered, such as user information and when the account was created.

Android.name: Skype Activity
Android.description: Skype Activity contains interactions that occurred between users on Skype. These interactions include messages, message drafts, group interactions, calls, sent/received files, and SMS. This information is recovered for Skype 8.1 and later.

Android.name: Skype Calls
Android.description: Skype Calls contains information about Skype calls that occur between users.

Android.name: Skype Chat Messages
Android.description: Skype Chat Messages contains Skype messages sent from one user to another.

Android.name: Skype Chatsync Messages
Android.description: Skype Chatsync Messages contains Skype messages that were sent from one user to another, and that are parsed from the chatsync directory.

Android.name: Skype Contacts
Android.description: Skype Contacts contains information about Skype contacts that are recovered, which may or may not be added contacts.

Android.name: Skype Emotions
Android.description: Skype Emotions contains the reactions of users to Skype messages.

Android.name: Skype File Transfers
Android.description: Skype File Transfers contains files that are transferred from one user to another using Skype.

Android.name: Skype Group Chat
Android.description: Skype Group Chat contains information about the Skype group chats that a user is a part of.

Android.name: Skype IP Addresses
Android.description: Skype IP Addresses contains the IP addresses that are associated with a Skype user account.

Android.name: Skype Notifications
Android.description: Skype Notifications contains notifications that were shown to users on Skype.

Android.name: Slack Accounts
Android.description: Slack Accounts contains account information on accounts signed onto the local device.

Android.name: Slack Channel Messages
Android.description: Slack Channel Messages contains messages sent or received in channels in the user's Slack workspace.

Android.name: Slack Channels
Android.description: Slack Channels contains information about each of the channels and conversations that exist in a user's Slack workspace.

Android.name: Slack Direct Messages
Android.description: Slack Direct Messages contains information about direct messages sent or received in 1:1 chats or group chats.

Android.name: Slack Files
Android.description: Slack Files contains information about any files that have saved to the Slack workspace. Files may or may not have been shared with other users.

Android.name: Slack Users
Android.description: Slack Users contains information about each user in the Slack workspace.

Android.name: Snapchat Accounts Information - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Accounts Information - Android contains information about the accounts that the user has logged in on the device with.

Android.name: Snapchat Cached Videos
Android.description: Snapchat Cached Videos contains the videos sent to the user.

Android.name: Snapchat Chat Messages
Android.description: Snapchat Chat Messages contains the chat messages sent between users.

Android.name: Snapchat Contacts
Android.description: Snapchat Contacts contains information about the user's Snapchat friends as well as contact information from the user's device that was requested by the Snapchat application.

Android.name: Snapchat Event Logs - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Event Logs - Android contains the events performed by the user.

Android.name: Snapchat Friends - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Friends - Android contains the friends of the user.

Android.name: Snapchat Group Members
Android.description: Snapchat Group Members contains information about participants of the groups that the local user is a member of.

Android.name: Snapchat Media Packages - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Media Packages - Android contains potential location information when taking a snap, text, or video was taken.

Android.name: Snapchat Memories
Android.description: Snapchat Memories contains pictures and videos that the Snapchat user saves as a memory.

Android.name: Snapchat Photo Transfers - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Photo Transfers - Android contains attributes of the photos sent between users.

Android.name: Snapchat Received Images - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Received Images - Android contains the photos that the user on device has received.

Android.name: Snapchat Received Snaps - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Received Snaps - Android contains Snaps containing pictures and videos that have been sent to the local user.

Android.name: Snapchat Segmented Videos
Android.description: Snapchat Segmented Videos contains videos that may have been viewed by the user.

Android.name: Snapchat Sent Snaps - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Sent Snaps - Android contains the snaps that have been sent by the user.

Android.name: Snapchat Stories - Android
Android.description: Snapchat Stories - Android contains information about Snapchat Stories that are recovered, along with any decrypted media content.

Android.name: TamTam Messenger Channels - Android
Android.description: TamTam Messenger Channels contains messages that belong to channel conversations recovered from the local device (the channel type must be User Channel or Default Channel).

Android.name: TamTam Messenger Contacts
Android.description: TamTam Messenger Contacts displays information about the TamTam contacts associated with the local user's account (including the local user).

Android.name: TamTam Messenger Conversations - Android
Android.description: TamTam Messenger Conversations contains information about all the chats recovered from the local device (includes individual, group, and channel messages).

Android.name: TamTam Messenger Groups - Android
Android.description: TamTam Messenger Groups contains all messages that belong to group conversations recovered from the local device.

Android.name: TamTam Messenger Messages - Android
Android.description: TamTam Messenger Messages contains all individual messages (one-to-one) recovered from the local device.

Android.name: Telegram Chats - Android
Android.description: Information about the conversations that the user participates in using the Telegram application.

Android.name: Telegram Contacts - Android
Android.description: Information about a subject's contacts that are displayed in Telegram. The application pulls the list of potential contacts from Android Contacts, meaning that these users may or may not be Telegram users.

Android.name: Telegram Messages - Android
Android.description: Individual chat messages that are sent and received using the Telegram application.

Android.name: Telegram Users - Android
Android.description: Information about the users that a subject has interacted with using Telegram.

Android.name: TeleGuard Accounts Information
Android.description: TeleGuard Accounts Information contains information about the account that the user has logged in with on the device.

Android.name: TeleGuard Channels
Android.description: TeleGuard Channels contains information about each of the channels subscribed to or created by the local user account.

Android.name: TeleGuard Contacts
Android.description: TeleGuard Users contains information about a user's TeleGuard contacts.

Android.name: TeleGuard Groups
Android.description: TeleGuard Groups contains information about a user's TeleGuard groups.

Android.name: TeleGuard Messages
Android.description: TeleGuard Messages contains information about the messages sent and received by the user.

Android.name: TeleGuard Posts
Android.description: TeleGuard Posts contains information about the posts that were published in the channels the user subscribed to or created.

Android.name: Textfree Attachments
Android.description: Textfree Attachments contains Attachments from the Android Textfree application.

Android.name: Textfree Contacts
Android.description: Textfree Contacts contains contacts from the Android Textfree application.

Android.name: Textfree Groups
Android.description: Textfree Groups contains information about group chats from the Android Textfree application.

Android.name: Textfree Messages / Calls
Android.description: Messages from the Android Textfree application.

Android.name: TextMe Calls
Android.description: TextMe Calls contains information about the calls that the user participates in using the TextMe application.

Android.name: TextMe Messages
Android.description: TextMe Messages contains individual chat messages that are sent and received using the TextMe application.

Android.name: TextPlus Activity
Android.description: TextPlus Activity contains information about messages and calls from TextPlus on an Android device.

Android.name: TextPlus Calls

Android.name: Potential Browser Activity
Android.description: The Browser Activity artifact will recover browser-related URLs. This includes Chrome Incognito and Firefox Private Browsing URLs, HTTP request artifacts from multiple browsers, and regular web browsing artifacts. This does not include metadata such as the Windows username, dates/times, and so on. Note that some recovered URLs can be from background browser processes related to certificate authorities, etc.

Android.name: Puffin Browser History

Android.name: Rebuilt Webpages

Android.name: Samsung Browser Archived Keyword Search Terms

Android.name: Samsung Browser Archived Web History

Android.name: Samsung Browser Autofill

Android.name: Samsung Browser Autofill Profiles

Android.name: Samsung Browser Bookmarks

Android.name: Samsung Browser Cache Records

Android.name: Samsung Browser Cached Thumbnails

Android.name: Samsung Browser Cookies

Android.name: Samsung Browser Current Session

Android.name: Samsung Browser Current Tabs

Android.name: Samsung Browser Downloads
Android.description: Information about the files that a user downloads from the Internet.

Android.name: Samsung Browser FavIcons
Android.description: Contains the favicons that Samsung Browser displays in the address bar for the website that's currently displayed. These icons are sometimes downloaded when you favorite/bookmark a website.

Android.name: Samsung Browser History Index
Android.description: An index of the webpages the user has visited in the past.

Android.name: Samsung Browser Keyword Search Terms
Android.description: Information about the keyword search terms that a user enters.

Android.name: Samsung Browser Last Session

Android.name: Samsung Browser Last Tabs

Android.name: Samsung Browser Logins

Android.name: Samsung Browser Media History

Android.name: Samsung Browser Saved Credit Cards

Android.name: Samsung Browser Saved Pages
Android.description: Samsung Browser Saved Pages contains information about web pages that were saved for offline viewing by the user. This includes basic page data, preview icon, user and device info. In addition, an .mhtml backup of the page is recovered, if it wasn't deleted.

Android.name: Samsung Browser Shortcuts
Android.description: Contains all of the shortcuts used by Google Samsung Browser for user entered URLs.

Android.name: Samsung Browser Tab History
Android.description: A history of websites the user has opened on each tab within the application. Each tab contains its own timeline of activity generated by the user.

Android.name: Samsung Browser Tabs
Android.description: Samsung Browser Tabs contains information about the tabs that the user has opened in the browser (not including private browsing). This artifact can also recover tabs that were opened but deleted.

Android.name: Samsung Browser Top Sites

Android.name: Samsung Browser Web History

Android.name: Samsung Browser Web Visits
Android.description: A history of the websites that the user visits (includes all visits).

Android.name: Sleipnir Cookies
Android.description: Sleipnir Cookies contains information about the cookies that the browser downloaded from the websites that were visted by the user.

Android.name: Sleipnir Search Terms
Android.description: Sleipnir Search Terms contains information about the keyword search terms that a user has provided in the browser.

Android.name: Sleipnir Web History
Android.description: Sleipnir Web History contains information about the websites that the user visited.

Android.name: UC Browser Bookmarks

Android.name: UC Browser Downloads
Android.description: UC Browser Downloads contains information about the files that a user downloads from the Internet.

Android.name: UC Browser History
Android.description: UC Browser History contains information about the websites that the user visits.

Android.name: WebKit Browser Session/Tabs (Carved)
Android.description: WebKit Browser Sessions/Tabs contains information about the browser sessions and tabs that the user has open, while using a browser built with WebKit. Some examples of browsers that use WebKit are Chrome, Opera, and 360 Safe Browser. This artifact consolidates the existing Chrome, Safe Browser, and Opera equivalents in a single artifact. Usage of other browsers, such as Firefox and Safari, aren't likely to appear under this artifact.

Android.name: WebKit Browser Web History (Carved)
Android.description: WebKit Browser Web History contains information about the websites that a user visits while using a browser built with WebKit. Some examples of browsers that use WebKit are Chrome, Opera, and 360 Safe Browser. This artifact consolidates the existing Chrome, Safe Browser, and Opera equivalents in a single artifact. Usage of other browsers aren't likely to appear under this artifact, however, some URLs found by other browsers may also be found by this artifact.

Android.description: Yandex Sync Data contains information about the data that Yandex has synced to a user's account in the cloud.

Android.name: YARA Rule Matches
Android.description: The YARA artifact contains information about files and processes that matched with conditions specified in a YARA rule.

Chromebook.name: Android Backups
Chromebook.description: Android Backups contains information about any backups of Android devices that are recovered from the computer. If an Android backup is recovered during a search, you can search the contents of the backup for additional artifacts.

Chromebook.name: Apple Disk Images
Chromebook.description: Apple disk images are commonly stored as DMG or IMG files. These files are containers that may contain additional items of interest. This artifact identifies any Apple disk image found on the system.

Chromebook.name: iOS Backups
Chromebook.description: iOS Backups contains information about any backups of iOS devices that are recovered from the computer. If an iOS backup is recovered during a search, you can search the contents of the backup for additional artifacts.

Chromebook.name: Virtual Machines
Chromebook.description: Virtual Machine files that have been found on the object being searched.

Chromebook.name: Dynamic Application Finder
Chromebook.description: Artifacts found using the Dynamic Application Finder vary depending on your case's evidence. To learn more, see Processing details > Find more artifacts in the AXIOM User Guide.

Chromebook.name: Activity Manager History
Chromebook.description: Activity Manager History contains a list of recent activity manager events, identified by the package name that triggered the event.

Chromebook.name: Android Application Roles
Chromebook.description: Android Application Roles contains a list of the default set application for specific functions in Android.

Chromebook.name: Android Device Information
Chromebook.description: Android Device Information contains the phone identification values.

Chromebook.name: Android Usage History
Chromebook.description: Android Usage History contains information about the usage and activity of applications that are running on the device.

Chromebook.name: Android Usage History (Dumpsys)
Chromebook.description: Android Usage History (Dumpsys) contains information about the usage and activity of applications running on the device, recovered using the dumpsys utility. The dates and times that were recovered by this artifact reflect the local time of the device.

Chromebook.name: Android User Dictionary
Chromebook.description: Contains the shortcuts and words the user has on his or her device.

Chromebook.name: Application Activity - Android
Chromebook.description: Application Activity represents the applications that are active in the background of the operating system.

Chromebook.name: Application Permissions - Android
Chromebook.description: Application Permissions contains information about the application permissions that a user has granted or declined.

Chromebook.name: Application Power Usage
Chromebook.description: Application Power Usage represents the amount of battery power consumed by each application since the device's last full charge.

Chromebook.name: Application Runtime Permissions
Chromebook.description: Application Runtime Permissions contains information about the application permissions that a user has granted or declined while the application is running.

Chromebook.name: Digital Wellbeing Events
Chromebook.description: Digital Wellbeing Events contains information about events that are tracked by the Digital Wellbeing app. Events describe state changes such as when an application pauses or resumes. Digital Wellbeing is a system application that's available on most Android 9 and 10 devices. The app is used to track events and provide the user with options to limit their usage of applications and set up a sleep schedule to reduce device usage.

Chromebook.name: Digital Wellbeing Limits
Chromebook.description: Digital Wellbeing Limits is used for restricting the amount of time for application usage. An application is suspended once the time limit has been reached.

Chromebook.name: Google Play Application Details
Chromebook.description: Google Play Application Details contains more detailed information about the applications that a user has downloaded from Google Play. This information includes when the user last installed or updated an application, and how the user was referred to the application.

Chromebook.name: Google Play Installed Applications
Chromebook.description: Google Play Installed Applications lists each of the applications that were downloaded and installed from Google Play.

Chromebook.name: Google Play Searches
Chromebook.description: Google Play Searches contains the search queries that a user has performed in Google Play, and the date and time of when they were performed.

Chromebook.name: Installed Applications
Chromebook.description: Installed Applications contains a list of all of the applications on an Android device, including their versions.

Chromebook.name: Android Dropbox
Chromebook.description: Android Dropbox contains Dropbox file information recovered from a Kindle device.

Chromebook.name: Android Dropbox Account Info
Chromebook.description: Android Dropbox Account Info contains Dropbox account information recovered from a Kindle device.

Chromebook.name: MEGA Accounts
Chromebook.description: MEGA Accounts contains information about the accounts that the local user has logged in with on the device.

Chromebook.name: MEGA Chat
Chromebook.description: MEGA Chat contains messages sent and received by the local user.

Chromebook.name: MEGA Contacts
Chromebook.description: MEGA Contacts contains information about MEGA users that have communicated with the local user account.

Chromebook.name: AIM Buddies
Chromebook.description: Contains the AIM buddies that were recovered from an Android device.

Chromebook.name: AIM Messages
Chromebook.description: Contains the AIM messages that were recovered from and Android device.

Chromebook.name: Android Burner Conversations
Chromebook.description: Android Burner Conversations contains the Burner conversations that were recovered from an Android device.

Chromebook.name: Android Burner Numbers
Chromebook.description: Android Burner Numbers contains the Burner numbers that were recovered from an Android device.

Chromebook.name: Android Call Logs
Chromebook.description: Android Call Logs contains information about the phone calls that occur using the Android Phone application.

Chromebook.name: Android Call Logs (UFED Agent)
Chromebook.description: Android Call Logs (UFED Agent) contains calling logs from the Phone application on Android. These logs are recovered from <incoming_calls>, <outgoing_calls>, <missed_calls>, <unknown_calls> tags found in a UFED Report.xml.

Chromebook.name: Android Contacts
Chromebook.description: Android Contacts contains contact information from a recovered Android device.

Chromebook.name: Android Contacts (UFED Agent)
Chromebook.description: Android Contacts (UFED Agent) contains information recovered from the Contacts application on Android. These contacts are recovered from <contacts> tag found in a UFED Report.xml.

Chromebook.name: Android Google Hangouts Messages
Chromebook.description: Android Google Hangouts Messages contains the messages from Google Hangouts from an Android device.

Chromebook.name: Android Kik Messenger Attachments
Chromebook.description: Android Kik Messenger Attachments contains the attachments of messages from Kik Messenger from an Android device.

Chromebook.name: Android Kik Messenger Contacts
Chromebook.description: Android Kik Messenger Contacts contains information about a user's Kik Messenger contacts.

Chromebook.name: Android Kik Messenger Messages
Chromebook.description: Android Kik Messenger Messages contains Kik Messenger messages that were sent or received by the local user.

Chromebook.name: Android Messages
Chromebook.description: SMS/MMS messages sent and received using Android Messages.

Chromebook.name: Android MMS
Chromebook.description: MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. These messages are recovered from mmssms.db.

Chromebook.name: Android MMS (UFED Agent)
Chromebook.description: Android MMS (UFED Agent) contains MMS messages sent or received using the Messages app on Android. These messages are recovered from <mms_messages> tags found in a UFED Report.xml

Chromebook.name: Android Sim Card Information
Chromebook.description: Android SIM Card Information is information about the device's SIM card that is recoverable if the user has the Android Messages application installed on the device.

Chromebook.name: Android SMS
Chromebook.description: SMS messages sent using the Messages app on Android.

Chromebook.name: Android SMS (UFED Agent)
Chromebook.description: Android SMS (UFED Agent) contains SMS messages sent or received using the Messages app on Android. These messages are recovered from <sms_messages> tags found in a UFED Report.xml.

Chromebook.name: Android SMS/MMS
Chromebook.description: SMS and MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. These messages are recovered from mmssms.db.

Chromebook.name: Android SMS/MMS (Content Provider)
Chromebook.description: SMS/MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. Data for this artifact is recovered during the acquisition process using an Android Content Provider.

Chromebook.name: Android SMS/MMS (Google Play Services)
Chromebook.description: SMS and MMS messages sent or received using an Android device. These messages are recovered from icing_mmssms.db.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Accounts Information
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Accounts Information contains information about the accounts that the user has logged in on the device with.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Event Logs
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Event Logs contains the events performed by the user.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Friends
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Friends contains the friends of the user.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Photo Transfers
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Photo Transfers contains attributes of the photos sent between users.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Received Images
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Received Images contains the photos that the user on device has received.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Received Snaps
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Received Snaps contains Snaps containing pictures and videos that have been sent to the local user.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Sent Snaps
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Sent Snaps contains the snaps that have been sent by the user.

Chromebook.name: Android Snapchat Stories
Chromebook.description: Android Snapchat Stories contains information about Snapchat Stories that are recovered, along with any decrypted media content.

Chromebook.description: Information about a subject's contacts that are displayed in Telegram. The application pulls the list of potential contacts from Android Contacts, meaning that these users may or may not be Telegram users.

Chromebook.name: Android TextNow Chat
Chromebook.description: Android TextNow Chat contains chat messages that are sent and received through the TextNow application.

Chromebook.description: Android TextNow Contacts contains the application, phone, email and group contacts that a user has in the TextNow application.

Chromebook.name: Android TextNow Groups
Chromebook.description: Android TextNow Groups contains membership information for TextNow group chats.

Chromebook.name: Android TextNow Profile
Chromebook.description: Android TextNow Profile contains TextNow user profiles and application preference settings.

Chromebook.name: Android TigerText Messages
Chromebook.description: Android TigerText Messages contains messages from the TigerText Android application.

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Accounts Information
Chromebook.description: WhatsApp Accounts Information Contains the login information for the user's account, including the private key used for authentication.

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Chats
Chromebook.description: WhatsApp Chats contains information about chat sessions that occur between the local user and another user or group. This artifact indicates the IDs of each participant as well as information about unread messages and the time when the last message was sent.

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Contacts

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Groups
Chromebook.description: Android WhatsApp Groups contains information about the WhatsApp Group chats that the user participates in.

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Live Locations
Chromebook.description: Android WhatsApp Live Locations captures Live Locations that are shared with the local device user. The coordinates in each result represent the sender's last shared location. Once a Live Location expires, it is no longer recoverable.

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Messages

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp Profile Pictures
Chromebook.description: Android WhatsApp Profile contains profile pictures that WhatsApp uses that are stored locally.

Chromebook.name: Android WhatsApp User Profiles
Chromebook.description: WhatsApp User Profiles contains profile information about the local WhatsApp user.

Chromebook.name: Burner Numbers

Chromebook.description: Discord Messages contains information about messages and calls that are sent and received using Discord. Messages from some channels might be missing if they haven't been cached by the application. This artifact uses both parsing and carving techniques to recover messages.

Chromebook.name: Facebook Messenger Calls

Chromebook.description: Facebook Messenger Groups contains data about group chats on Facebook Messenger.

Chromebook.name: Glide Messages

Chromebook.name: Google Meet Meeting History

Chromebook.name: GroupMe Accounts

Chromebook.description: GroupMe Contacts contains information about a user's contacts.

Chromebook.name: GroupMe Groups
Chromebook.description: GroupMe Groups contains information about the groups that the logged-in user is a member of.

Chromebook.name: GroupMe Messages
Chromebook.description: GroupMe Messages contains the messages sent and received using GroupMe.

Chromebook.name: Gtalk Contacts

Chromebook.description: KakaoTalk Messages contains messages sent or received using KakaoTalk.

Chromebook.name: LINE Chats

Chromebook.name: Web Video Fragments

RTMP Frame Fragments are frames left behind by streaming sites using the RTMP protocol (widely used by webcam chat sites, including Chatroulette and Camstumble). In this case, a thumbnail from a recovered video is displayed, as well as any relevant metadata. Videos can be exported to .FLV format to be played. Due to the nature of the data recovered, some video players will have issues playing the exported files. We recommend trying FFmpeg, VLC, and the GOM player.
