Chromebook.description: Yandex Bookmarks contains browser bookmarks that reference saved webpages.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Cookies
Chromebook.description: Yandex Cookies contains the cookies that Yandex downloads from the Internet. These cookies contain information about the websites that a user visits.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Downloads
Chromebook.description: Yandex Downloads contains information about the files that a user downloads from the Internet.

Chromebook.name: Yandex FavIcons
Chromebook.description: Yandex Favicons contains the favicons that Yandex displays in the address bar for the website that's currently displayed. These icons are sometimes downloaded when you favorite/bookmark a website.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Keyword Search Terms
Chromebook.description: Yandex Keyword Search Terms contains information about the keyword search terms that a user enters.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Logins
Chromebook.description: Yandex Logins contains login information that a user provides in Yandex. Passwords are often encrypted, so you might not be able to recover those unless you're examining a live system.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Shortcuts
Chromebook.description: Yandex Shortcuts contains all of the shortcuts used by Yandex for user entered URLs.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Sync Data
Chromebook.description: Yandex Sync Data contains information about the data that Yandex has synced to a user's account in the cloud.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Top Sites
Chromebook.description: Yandex Top Sites contains a list of the websites that are the most popular to the user. Top sites are displayed on the browser home page which allows the user to quickly click on a frequently visited site.

Chromebook.name: Yandex Web History
Chromebook.description: Yandex Web History a history of the websites that the user visits (includes unique visits only).

Chromebook.name: Yandex Web Visits
Chromebook.description: Yandex Web Visits contains a history of the websites that the user visits (includes all visits).

Chromebook.name: YARA Rule Matches
Chromebook.description: The YARA artifact contains information about files and processes that matched with conditions specified in a YARA rule.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Activity
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Activity contains Google activity entries retrieved from the Google Activity website.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Aggregated Activities (Identity Sessions)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Aggregated Activities (Identity Sessions) contains an aggregated representation of connections between identifiers seen together in authenticated sessions. This artifact is typically found in Google Warrant Return data under Access Log Activity.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Aggregated Activities (Service Access Summary)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Aggregated Activities (Service Access Summary) contains an aggregated representation of the Google services accessed by a device. This artifact is typically found in Google Warrant Return data under Access Log Activity.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Connected Apps
Cloud.description: Google Connected Apps recovered from the Cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Pay Billing Information (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Contains billing information and payment instrument details from Google Pay warrant returns. Includes highly sensitive financial data such as full card numbers, expiration dates, card schemes, prepaid indicators, and linked payment service accounts (PayPal, carrier billing). Each record represents a single payment instrument associated with a Google Payments profile.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Pay Payment Info (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Pay Payment Info (Warrant Return) contains information about payment methods (credit cards, debit cards, bank accounts) stored in a user's Google Pay account, as provided in a warrant return from Google.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Play Store Installs (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Play Store Installs (Warrant Return) contains information about applications installed on devices associated with a Google Account, extracted from the Google Play Store Installs CSV file in a Google Warrant Return. This artifact provides forensic insight into what applications were present on a device, when they were installed or updated, and how they were acquired. Install source and system app status help distinguish user-initiated installs from pre-loaded software.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Saved Collections (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Saved Collections extracted from Warrant Return data. Contains the user's saved collections from Google services, including bookmarked places, saved images, watchlists, and other content. Each row represents either a saved item within a collection or an empty collection with its metadata.

Cloud.name: Cloud Amazon CloudTrail Events
Cloud.description: Cloud Amazon CloudTrail Events contains records of activities in an AWS account. The activity can be an action taken by an IAM identity, or service that is monitorable by CloudTrail. CloudTrail events provide a history of both API and non-API account activity made through the AWS Management Console, AWS SDKs, command line tools, and other AWS services.

Cloud.name: Cloud Amazon CloudTrail Insights
Cloud.description: AWS CloudTrail Insights provides automated analysis of unusual activity patterns in an AWS account by identifying abnormal operational behavior.

Cloud.name: Cloud Amazon EC2 Instances
Cloud.description: EC2 instances are virtual machines that corporations use for hosting secure services and storing data securely in the cloud. To acquire this data, Magnet AXIOM exports this instance to Amazon's S3 service and downloads it from there.

Cloud.name: Cloud Amazon S3 Files
Cloud.description: Cloud Amazon S3 Files contains information about files that are stored in Amazon S3 and are recovered from the cloud. Amazon S3 is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Android Backups
Cloud.description: Cloud Android Backups contains a list of device information for which an Android Backup was created.

Cloud.name: Cloud Azure Virtual Machine Snapshots
Cloud.description: Azure virtual machines are on-demand computing resources used by organizations for hosting services and storing data securely in the cloud. To acquire this data, Magnet AXIOM creates snapshots of all disks attached to a given virtual machine, and downloads the snapshots for analysis.

Cloud.name: Cloud Box.com Enterprise Events
Cloud.description: The Cloud Box Enterprise event contains information about administrative events that are triggered by user actions. Some examples of events include new user creation, successful login, and item syncs. You can see a full list at https://developer.box.com/v2.0/reference#enterprise-events.

Cloud.name: Cloud Box.com Files
Cloud.description: Files that are stored in Box that are recovered from the cloud. Box is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access or share them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Box.com User Events
Cloud.description: The Cloud Box User Events artifact contains information about actions that are triggered by the user. Some examples of events include item creation, upload, and download. You can see a full list of events at https://developer.box.com/v2.0/reference#user-events.

Cloud.name: Cloud Dropbox Files
Cloud.description: Files that are stored in Dropbox that are recovered from the cloud. Dropbox is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Drive Activity
Cloud.description: Google Drive Activity contains information about actions performed on Google Drive files, folders, and drives.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Drive File Version History
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Drive File Version History contains file revisions that are stored in Google Drive and are recovered from the cloud. Google Drive is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Drive Files
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Drive Files contains files that are stored in Google Drive that are recovered from the cloud. Google Drive is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Workspace Drive Audit Events
Cloud.description: Google Workspace Drive Events contains event information about the Google Drive activity on a Google Workspace domain.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Workspace Login Audit Events
Cloud.description: Google Workspace Login Events contains information about the events and parameters for login activity on a Google Workspace domain.

Cloud.name: Cloud iCloud Backups
Cloud.description: Backups of iOS devices that the user creates, and which are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud iCloud Drive Files
Cloud.description: Files that are stored in iCloud Drive that are recovered from the cloud. iCloud Drive is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud iCloud Keychain
Cloud.description: iCloud keychain values that are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Mega Files
Cloud.description: Cloud Mega Files contains files that are stored in Mega that are recovered from the cloud. Mega is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Microsoft Unified Audit Logs
Cloud.description: Cloud Microsoft Unified Audit Logs contains events from Microsoft Unified Audit Log. This artifact collects information from SharePoint, Azure, and Exchange. SharePoint collects ItemType, SiteUrl, SourceFileName, and DestinationFileName information. Azure collects ResultStatus, and Client information. Exchange collects ClientInfoString, LogonType, MailboxOwnerUPN, Subject, and ExternalAccess information.

Cloud.name: Cloud OneDrive File Version History
Cloud.description: Cloud Office 365 OneDrive File Version History contains information about previous versions of a file stored on OneDrive.

Cloud.name: Cloud OneDrive Files
Cloud.description: Cloud OneDrive Files contains files that are stored in OneDrive that are recovered from the cloud. OneDrive is a file hosting service that allows users to upload and sync files to the cloud and access them from multiple locations.

Cloud.name: Samsung Cloud Backups - Call Logs
Cloud.description: Samsung Cloud Backups - Call Logs contains the call logs of a user, as recovered from a backup.

Cloud.name: Samsung Cloud Backups - Connections
Cloud.description: Samsung Cloud Backups - Connections contains the network connections of a user, as recovered from a backup.

Cloud.name: Samsung Cloud Backups - Contacts
Cloud.description: Samsung Cloud Backups - Contacts contains the contacts of a user, as recovered from a backup.

Cloud.name: Samsung Cloud Backups - Devices
Cloud.description: Samsung Cloud Backups - Devices contains a list of device information for which a Samsung Cloud Backup was created.

Cloud.name: Samsung Cloud Backups - Messages
Cloud.description: Samsung Cloud Backups - Messages contains SMS and MMS data stored in a Samsung Cloud Backup recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Samsung Cloud Backups - Voice Recordings
Cloud.description: Samsung Cloud Backups - Voice Recordings contains audio voice recordings stored in a Samsung Cloud Backup recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Apple Contacts
Cloud.description: Cloud Apple Contacts contains information about the contacts and services that a user has saved to their Apple account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Apple iMessages
Cloud.description: Apple iMessages acquired from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Apple iMessages (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Apple iMessages parsed from a Apple Warrant Return archive.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Conversations
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Conversations contains conversation metadata created by the local user with ChatGPT models. Conversations can be temporary or saved, and they include information such as the title, id and timestamps.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Group Conversation Members
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Group Conversation Members contains metadata for the group member using ChatGPT.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Group Conversations
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Group Conversations contains group conversation metadata created by the user(s) with ChatGPT models. Group conversations include information such as the title, id, and timestamps.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Messages represents individual prompts and responses exchanged within a Cloud ChatGPT Conversation, including timestamps, directionality, model usage, attachment indicators, and extracted attachment content. Messages with multiple attachments generate one hit per attachment.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Projects
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Projects contains metadata for the projects created by the user in ChatGPT.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT User Details
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT User Details contains metadata for the user using ChatGPT.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot Conversations
Cloud.description: Copilot Conversations contains conversation metadata from Microsoft Copilot cloud returns. Each entry represents a conversation with its title, type, timestamps, and group/pinned status.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot Group Conversations
Cloud.description: Cloud Copilot Group Conversations contains group conversation metadata from Microsoft Copilot cloud returns. Each entry represents a group conversation with its participants, ownership, notification settings, and access controls.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot Group Members
Cloud.description: Cloud Copilot Group Members contains aggregated participant data from Microsoft Copilot group conversations. Each entry represents a unique user with their display name and the list of groups they belong to.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot Library Pages
Cloud.description: Copilot Library Pages contains user-curated content pages saved from Microsoft Copilot conversations. Each entry represents a page with its title, content body, associated conversation, and modification timestamp.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Copilot Messages represents individual prompts and responses exchanged within a Microsoft Copilot cloud conversation, including timestamps, directionality, content classification, and extracted attachment content. Messages with multiple attachments generate one entry per attachment.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot User Details
Cloud.description: Cloud Copilot User Details contains user identifiers extracted from the account owner's user.json profile and from groupParticipant authors in Microsoft Copilot group conversation messages.

Cloud.name: Cloud Facebook Messenger Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Facebook Messenger Messages contains Facebook Messages recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Calls (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Calls (Warrant Return) contains call log information obtained from Google through warrant return data. This includes details about phone calls, voicemails, and related metadata such as timestamps, participants, call status, and user actions like starring, archiving, or marking as spam.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Chat (Takeout, Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Chat parsed from a Google Takeout or Warrant Return archive.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Chat (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Chat parsed from a Google Warrant Return archive.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Chat Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Chat Messages contains chat messages stored in the Google Chat service which are recovered from the cloud via their public API.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Chat Spaces
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Chat Spaces contains space information stored in the Google Chat service which is recovered from the cloud via their public API.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Contacts
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Contacts contains information about the contacts and services that a user has saved to their Google account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Contacts (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Contacts (Warrant Return) contains contact directory information parsed from vCard 3.0 (.vcf) files included in Google warrant return packages. Contacts are organized one VCF file per contact group (For example, All Contacts, Family, Starred in Android).

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Export Summary (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Export Summary (Warrant Return) contains inbox state information obtained from Google Voice through warrant return data. This includes a timestamp of when the export was generated and a summary of thread categories (such as ALL, TEXTS, CALLS, VOICEMAILS_AND_RECORDINGS) with their corresponding unread message counts.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Gemini Conversations
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gemini Conversations contains metadata for chat conversations from Google Gemini.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Gemini Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gemini Messages represents individual user prompts and AI responses exchanged within a Google Gemini conversation. Each conversation entry is split into two separate hits: one for the user's request and one for Gemini's response. Includes timestamps, message threading via parent IDs, and attachment content from both uploads and AI-generated media.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Gemini Notebooks
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gemini Notebooks contains metadata for notebooks from Google Gemini.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Gemini User Details
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gemini User Details contains metadata for the Google Gemini user.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Hangouts Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Hangouts Messages contains Google Hangouts messages that are sent or received by the logged in user and recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Hangouts Messages (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Hangouts Messages parsed from a Google Warrant Return archive.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Mail Message Information (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Gmail message metadata extracted from Google Warrant Return Message Information JSON exports. Contains detailed SMTP delivery information, user interaction timestamps (read, archived, replied), and email authentication data. Use Thread ID to correlate with Gmail Messages artifact for full message content.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Voice Contacts Metadata (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Contains contact metadata from Google Voice warrant return documents. Includes contact identification, spam classification history, proxy number assignments, call metadata, and off-network interaction counts for forensic analysis of Google Voice account contacts.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Voice Subscriber Information (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Contains subscriber account information and forwarding device configurations from Google Voice warrant return documents. Each record represents a forwarding destination (cellular phone or SIP device) configured on the Google Voice account, along with account-level context including subscriber identification, activity timestamps, and account settings. This artifact is critical for linking devices to Google Voice accounts, establishing patterns of use through activity timestamps, and tracking account lifecycle events. Forwarding devices may include cellular phone numbers or SIP URIs for iOS/Android devices running the Google Voice app.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Voice Text (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Contains Google Voice text message data (SMS/MMS) from warrant return documents. Includes message content, attachments, conversation metadata, and user actions.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Voicemail (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Contains Google voicemail data from warrant return documents. Includes message details, transcripts, media files, and metadata about voicemail status and user actions.

Cloud.name: Cloud Microsoft Teams Conversations
Cloud.description: Cloud Microsoft Teams Conversations contains information about each of the channels and group messages that exist in a user's Teams environment, which were recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Microsoft Teams Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Microsoft Teams Messages contains messages that were sent and received between Teams members and are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Microsoft Teams Teams
Cloud.description: Cloud Microsoft Teams Teams contains information about Microsoft Teams as recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Skype Account Details (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Skype Account Details (Warrant Return) contains information about the target account of the warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Skype Chat History Records (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Skype Chat History Records (Warrant Return) contains the chat history of a user, including calls and shared attachments, as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Skype Connection History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Skype Connection History (Warrant Return) contains information regarding the account activity that was extracted from warrant returns provided by Skype.

Cloud.name: Cloud Skype Contacts (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Skype Contacts (Warrant return) contains the contacts of a user, as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Slack Channels
Cloud.description: Cloud Slack Channels contains information about each of the channels and conversations that exist in a user's Slack workspace. These Slack channels are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Slack Files
Cloud.description: Cloud Slack Files contains information about the files that a user has downloaded locally from the URLs that they've viewed within Slack, and that have been recovered from the cloud . Data about the downloads are recovered from Slack Workspace Corporate exports.

Cloud.name: Cloud Slack Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Slack Messages contains messages sent or received in channels in the user's Slack workspace, and that are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Slack Users
Cloud.description: Cloud Slack Users contains information about each user in the Slack workspace that is recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Slack Workspaces
Cloud.description: Cloud Slack Workspaces contains information about each of the workspaces that the user is a member of. This information is recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud WhatsApp Backups
Cloud.description: Cloud WhatsApp Backups contains information about backups that are created by WhatsApp and stored in the cloud. Each backup is a database that contains information from the WhatsApp for Android application, such as the user's message history. Backups are recovered from the cloud through the user's Google Drive account.

Cloud.name: Cloud WhatsApp Chats
Cloud.description: Cloud WhatsApp Chats are messages that are retrieved from a subject's account using their WhatsApp QR code login.

Cloud.name: Facebook Messenger Messages (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Facebook Messenger Messages (Warrant Return) contains individual messages that are parsed from chat threads that Facebook has included in a warrant return. The 'messages' in a chat thread can include messages, shared files or links, calls, and audio messages.

Cloud.name: Snapchat Account Information (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat Account Information (Warrant Return) contains information about the target account of the warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat Friends (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat Friends (Warrant Return) contains information about the user's friends, which are parsed from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat Geolocation (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Snapchat Geolocation (Warrant Return) contains information about the geolocation associated with the user's Snapchat activity.

Cloud.name: Snapchat Group Chat Messages (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat Group Chat Messages (Warrant Return) contains information about the messages sent and received by users participating in a group chat thread, and which are parsed from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat IP Account Changes (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat IP Account Changes (Warrant Return) contains IP addresses captured when changes were made to the account (For example, display name, phone number), as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat IP Friend Events (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat IP Friend Events (Warrant Return) contains IP addresses captured from friend events including the sender, recipient, and type of friending action, as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat IP History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat IP History (Warrant Return) contains information about the IP addresses that are associated with a user's account logins, as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat IP Login History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat IP Login History (Warrant Return) contains detailed IP login and logout event data including action type, user agent, status, and verification method, as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat IP Login Status History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat IP Login Status History (Warrant Return) contains IP addresses captured from login history events along with the login status and completed authentication challenges, as recovered from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Snapchat Messages (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Snapchat Messages (Warrant Return) contains information about the messages that are sent or received by a user, and are parsed from a warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Access Log Devices (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Access Log Devices (Warrant Return) contains information about devices that have accessed the Google Account in the last 30 days, extracted from Access Log Activity warrant return files.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Account Target Association (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Account Target Association (Warrant Return) contains information about Google accounts associated with a target phone number, including the connection status and how the phone number is used by each account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Devices
Cloud.description: Google Devices contains information about the target account of the warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Recent Devices
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Recent Devices contains Google recent devices that were recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Apple Notes (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Apple Notes parsed from an iCloud Warrant Return archive.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Keep
Cloud.description: The Cloud Google Keep artifact contains notes and lists that the user wrote and saved to their Google account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Tasks
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Tasks contains information about the tasks that a user has saved to their Google account, and that were recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Gmail Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gmail Messages contains Gmail message contents and Gmail attachments that are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Gmail Messages (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Gmail messages parsed from a Google Warrant Return mbox export.

Cloud.name: Cloud Gmail User Settings (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Gmail User Settings (Warrant Return) contains account configuration data extracted from the Gmail All User Settings JSON file in a Google Warrant Return. This includes blocked senders, mail filters, delegated sender addresses, forwarding addresses, account creation and last activity timestamps, protocol settings, and data processing consent states. This artifact provides forensic context about how the account was configured and may reveal evidence of account compromise or data exfiltration through unexpected forwarding rules or delegated access.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Calendar Events
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Calendar Events contains information about the entries a user has saved to their Google Calendar.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Calendar Events (Takeout)
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Calendar Events (Takeout) contains information about the entries that a user has saved to their Google Calendar.

Cloud.name: Cloud iCloud Mail
Cloud.description: Cloud iCloud Mail contains the messages and attachments recovered from an iCloud Mail account.

Cloud.name: Cloud IMAP/POP Emails
Cloud.description: Cloud IMAP/POP Emails contains messages and attachments from an IMAP/POP account that are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud MBOX Emails
Cloud.description: Cloud MBOX Emails contains the messages and attachments that were recovered from an MBOX file and from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Outlook Calendar
Cloud.description: Cloud Outlook Calendar contains information about the entries a user has saved to their Outlook Calendar, which are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Outlook Contacts
Cloud.description: Cloud Outlook Contacts contains information about the entries that a user has saved to their Outlook contacts, which are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Outlook Mail
Cloud.description: Cloud Outlook Mail contains email messages and attachments that were sent and received using Microsoft mail services (such as Hotmail, or Outlook), which are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Passwords
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Passwords contains Google Passwords that are recovered from the Cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Location History
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Timeline Locations contains information about the locations that a user visits. The location history is captured by Google Timeline and recovered using Google Takeout. Google Timeline is a web service that allows a user to view the locations that they visit and the routes that they take.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Location History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Location History (Warrant Return) contains information about the locations that a user visits. The location history is associated with the Device Tag that Google assigns to the device.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Maps Activity (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Maps Activity (Warrant Return) contains information about the Google Maps actions that were executed by the account holder and found within a Warrant Return package.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Maps Labeled Places (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Maps Labeled Places (Warrant Return) contains the locations that the account holder labeled in Google Maps (such as Home and Work), found within a Warrant Return package. Each labeled place includes its address and precise GPS coordinates.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Semantic Location History - Activity Segment
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Semantic Location History - Activity Segment contains information about the activities that involved a change in location for a duration of time. The semantic location history is captured by Google Timeline and recovered using Google Takeout. Google Timeline is a web service that allows a user to view the locations that they visit and the routes that they take.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Semantic Location History - Place Visit
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Semantic Location History - Place Visit contains information about the locations that a user visited or stayed for a duration of time. The semantic location history is captured by Google Timeline and recovered using Google Takeout. Google Timeline is a web service that allows a user to view the locations that they visit and the routes that they take.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Timeline Locations
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Timeline Locations contains the locations that a user visits that are captured by Google Timeline, and recovered from the cloud. Google Timeline is a web service that allows a user to view the locations they travel and the routes that they take.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Library Files
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Library Files contains metadata for the library files on the user's ChatGPT account.

Cloud.name: Cloud ChatGPT Project Files
Cloud.description: Cloud ChatGPT Project Files contains metadata for the project files stored on the user's ChatGPT account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Copilot Library Images
Cloud.description: Copilot Library Images contains metadata and binary attachments for AI-generated images saved to the user's Microsoft Copilot library. Each entry represents one image with its source conversation, creation timestamp, and the downloaded PNG file.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Gemini My Stuff Files
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gemini My Stuff Files contains metadata and content for files stored in the user's Gemini My Stuff library. These files are typically images generated or shared during Gemini conversations.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Gemini Notebook Sources
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Gemini Notebook Sources contains metadata and content for files stored in the user's Gemini notebooks.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Photos
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Photos contains pictures stored in Google Photos which are recovered from the cloud. Google Photos is a cloud-based photo storage service that allows users to store, view and share their photos.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Photos (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Photos (Warrant Return) contains information about pictures recovered from the target user's Google account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Photos - AXIOM 2.8
Cloud.description: Cloud Google Photos contains pictures stored in Google Photos which are recovered from the cloud. Google Photos is a cloud-based photo storage service that allows users to store, view and share their photos. This artifact applies to Magnet AXIOM 2.8 and earlier.

Cloud.name: Cloud iCloud Photos
Cloud.description: Photos that are stored in iCloud Photo Library that are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Accounts Information
Cloud.description: Cloud Accounts Information contains the credentials of the acquired target account.

Cloud.name: Cloud Gmail Session Activity (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Cloud Gmail Session Activity (Warrant Return) contains session activity records extracted from the Gmail All User Settings JSON file in a Google Warrant Return. Each row represents a single session event including the source IP address, user agent, device identifier, and OAuth context. This data is valuable for establishing account access patterns, identifying devices and locations used to access the account, and correlating activity with other forensic timeline events.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Account Change History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Account Change History (Warrant Return) contains information about changes made to a Google account, including settings changes, security events, and service modifications.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Account Information (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Account Information (Warrant Return) contains information about the target account of the warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Google Login History (Warrant Return)
Cloud.description: Google Login History (Warrant Return) contains information about the logins and logouts made by the user account of the warrant return.

Cloud.name: Cloud Facebook Friends
Cloud.description: Cloud Facebook Friends contains information about the user's Facebook friends that was recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Facebook Mobile Timeline
Cloud.description: Cloud Facebook Mobile Timeline contains Facebook timelines and their content, which are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Facebook Profile Info
Cloud.description: Cloud Facebook Profile Info contains Facebook profile information recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Facebook Timeline
Cloud.description: Cloud Facebook Timeline contains Facebook timelines and their content, which are recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Instagram Direct Messages
Cloud.description: Cloud Instagram direct messages that are sent or received by the logged in user and recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Instagram Posts
Cloud.description: Cloud Instagram Posts contains Instagram posts that are published by the logged in user and recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Instagram Posts - AXIOM 2.1
Cloud.description: Cloud Instagram Posts - AXIOM 2.1 contains instagram posts that are published by the logged in user and recovered from the cloud.

Cloud.name: Cloud Twitter Direct Messages

Computer.name: Apple Disk Images
Computer.description: Apple disk images are commonly stored as DMG or IMG files. These files are containers that may contain additional items of interest. This artifact identifies any Apple disk image found on the system.

Computer.name: iOS Backups
Computer.description: iOS Backups contains information about any backups of iOS devices that are recovered from the computer. If an iOS backup is recovered during a search, you can search the contents of the backup for additional artifacts.

Computer.name: Virtual Machines

Computer.name: Application Install States
Computer.description: Application Install States contains a list of state changes that occur while an application installs or is uninstalled on the computer.

Computer.name: Claude Command History
Computer.description: Claude Command History contains a chronological record of every user input entered across all Claude sessions and projects. This global command history is stored in %USERPROFILE%\.claude\history.jsonl and provides a complete timeline of user interactions with Claude, independent of individual conversation sessions. Commands include text prompts, code requests, slash commands (for example, /usage, /status, /exit), and any other user input typed into the Claude interface.

Computer.name: Claude Conversations
Computer.description: Claude Conversations contains conversations that the local user has with Claude AI models through the Claude Desktop application. The messages include text exchanges, code generation, analysis requests, and other interactions. Conversations are stored in JSONL transcript files organized by working directory and session.

Computer.name: Cowork Audit Logs
Computer.description: Cowork Audit Logs contain audit trails of Claude Desktop Cowork mode sessions. Each line in the audit.jsonl file is a discrete event with a timestamp, type, and associated metadata. Events include user messages, AI responses, thinking blocks (Claude's internal reasoning process), tool execution (file operations, commands, searches), rate limit tracking, system state changes, and HMAC integrity verification. The logs are stored in %LocalAppData%\Packages\Claude_*\LocalCache\Roaming\Claude\local-agent-mode-sessions\*\*\local_*\audit.jsonl.

Computer.name: Feature Usage
Computer.description: FeatureUsage is a registry key available in Windows 10 version 1903 and later. It contains information on user activity in the Windows taskbar such as app and tray item clicks.

Computer.name: Installed Microsoft Programs

Computer.name: Installed Programs

Computer.description: Yahoo Webmail Chat is a browser chat application that allows Yahoo Account holders to chat with other Yahoo users.

Computer.name: Zoom Chat Messages
Computer.description: Zoom Chat Messages contains details about Zoom chat messages sent outside of a meeting.

Computer.name: Zoom Meeting Messages
Computer.description: Zoom Meeting Messages contains details about Zoom chat messages sent during a meeting.

Computer.name: Zoom User Accounts
Computer.description: Zoom User Accounts contains details about the local user's zoom account.

Computer.name: Latent Wireless Geolocated Wifi Hotspots
Computer.description: Latent Wireless Geolocated WiFi Hotspots contains information about WiFi hotspots that were discovered using a Latent Wireless device. Latent Wireless stores information about the hotspots in a database that Magnet AXIOM can parse for details about each hotspot.

Computer.name: LogMeIn Activity
Computer.description: LogMeIn Activity records connection events that occur using the LogMeIn remote desktop client. These records can include remote sessions and file sharing events.

Computer.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
Computer.description: The Remote Desktop Protocol artifact can indicate whether a device accesses external network devices, or was accessed by external network devices. The data collected by this artifact is recovered from the Windows Event Log, as well as the Windows Registry.

Computer.name: Remote Desktop Protocol Bitmap Cache
Computer.description: Remote Desktop Protocol Bitmap Cache provides a reconstruction of the RDP Bitmap Cache, which gives an indication of what may have been on screen during an RDP session.

Computer.name: TeamViewer Activity
Computer.description: TeamViewer Activity contains information about incoming and outgoing remote connections using TeamViewer remote desktop software.

Computer.name: USB Devices
Computer.description: USB Devices contains a history of all USB devices that have been connected to the system.

Computer.name: Your Phone Contacts
Computer.description: Your Phone Contacts contains information about contacts synced from a mobile device to a computer using Your Phone. The Your Phone application can sync data from Android and iOS devices to computers running Windows 10.

Computer.name: Your Phone Devices
Computer.description: Your Phone Devices contains information about the devices that are synced to the user's computer by using the Your Phone application.

Computer.name: Your Phone Pictures
Computer.description: Your Phone Pictures contains information about pictures synced from a mobile device to a computer using Your Phone. The Your Phone application syncs the 25 most recently taken photos from Android and iOS devices to computers running Windows 10.

Computer.name: Your Phone SMS/MMS
Computer.description: Your Phone SMS/MMS contains information about messages synced from a mobile device to a computer using Your Phone. The Your Phone application can sync data from Android and iOS devices to computers running Windows 10.

Computer.name: File Signature Mismatch (Audio)
Computer.description: File Signature Mismatch (Audio) contains identified mismatches between a known file signature header and the extension (or lack thereof) for an audio file. A mismatch might occur when a user changes or removes the extension for a file as a way to avoid detection.

Computer.name: File Signature Mismatch (Container)
Computer.description: File Signature Mismatch (Container) contains identified mismatches between a known file signature header and the extension (or lack thereof) for a container. A mismatch might occur when a user changes or removes the extension for a file as a way to avoid detection.

Computer.name: File Signature Mismatch (Document)
Computer.description: File Signature Mismatch (Document) contains identified mismatches between a known file signature header and the extension (or lack thereof) for a document. A mismatch might occur when a user changes or removes the extension for a file as a way to avoid detection.

Computer.name: File Signature Mismatch (Picture)
Computer.description: File Signature Mismatch (Picture) contains identified mismatches between a known file signature header and the extension (or lack thereof) for a picture. A mismatch might occur when a user changes or removes the extension for a file as a way to avoid detection.

Computer.name: File Signature Mismatch (Video)
Computer.description: File Signature Mismatch (Video) contains identified mismatches between a known file signature header and the extension (or lack thereof) for a video. A mismatch might occur when a user changes or removes the extension for a file as a way to avoid detection.

Computer.name: CSV Documents
Computer.description: CSV Documents contains CSV documents (.csv) that are located on the system.

Computer.name: Google Docs
Computer.description: Google Docs is a word processing suite available to all Google account holders.

Computer.name: Hangul Word Processor
Computer.description: Hangul Word Processor specifies information about files created using Hangul Word Processor.

Computer.name: Microsoft Excel Documents
Computer.description: Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet processor developed by Microsoft.

Computer.name: Microsoft Office 365 MRU Document Requests
Computer.description: Includes a user's most recently requested documents in Microsoft Office 365.

Computer.name: Microsoft Office 365 MRU Documents
Computer.description: Includes a user's most recently accessed documents in Microsoft Office 365.

Computer.name: Microsoft Office 365 MRU Place Requests
Computer.description: Includes a user's most recently requested folders in Microsoft Office 365.

Computer.name: Microsoft Office 365 MRU Places
Computer.description: Includes a user's most recently accessed folders in Microsoft Office 365.

Computer.name: Microsoft Office Backstage Items
Computer.description: Microsoft Office Backstage Items are items that can be found in the Backstage View of Microsoft Office applications.

Computer.name: Microsoft PowerPoint Documents
Computer.description: Microsoft PowerPoint is a presentation creator developed by Microsoft. This table captures documents created with PowerPoint, extracted from the filesystem and carved from unallocated space.

Computer.name: Microsoft Sticky Notes
Computer.description: Microsoft Sticky Notes contains content stored in Sticky Notes.

Computer.name: Microsoft Word Documents
Computer.description: Microsoft Word is a word processor developed by Microsoft.

Computer.name: OpenOffice Calc Documents
Computer.description: OpenOffice Calc Documents are spreadsheets similar to Microsoft Excel spreadsheets, but are created using OpenOffice Calc.

Computer.name: OpenOffice Impress Documents
Computer.description: OpenOffice Impress Documents are slide presentations similar to Microsoft PowerPoint presentations, but created using OpenOffice Impress.

Computer.name: OpenOffice Writer Documents
Computer.description: OpenOffice Writer Documents are documents similar to Microsoft Word documents, but are created using OpenOffice Writer.

Computer.name: PDF Documents
Computer.description: Portable Document Format (PDF) is a file format used to present documents in a manner independent of application software, hardware, and operating systems. This table captures documents in this file format, extracted from the filesystem and carved from unallocated space.

Computer.name: RTF Documents
Computer.description: The information for each RTF document that was recovered from the search.

Computer.name: Text Documents
Computer.description: Text documents (.txt) that are located on the system.

Computer.name: Calendar Events (ICS)
Computer.description: Calendar Events (ICS) contains information about events and appointments that are recovered from calendar .ics files. These files are used by many different email applications, including Outlook, Google Calendar, and Apple Calendar.

Computer.name: EML(X) Files
Computer.description: EML(X) Files contains the emails in .eml and .emlx formats, that have been found on the device.

Computer.name: Gmail Fragments
Computer.description: Gmail Email Fragments contains the Gmail email fragments that were recovered from a Windows or OS X computer.

Computer.name: Gmail Webmail
Computer.description: Gmail is a webmail website that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: GMX Webmail
Computer.description: GMX webmail website that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: Hotmail Webmail
Computer.description: Hotmail is a web-based email client that allows users to send and receive emails. Hotmail was replaced by Outlook.com in 2012.

Computer.name: Hushmail Fragments
Computer.description: Hushmail Fragments contains fragments of messages sent and received using Hushmail. Recovered data can include the email sender, receiver, and message fragments.

Computer.name: Hushmail Inbox
Computer.description: Hushmail Inbox contains messages sent and received using Hushmail Webmail. Recovered data can include the email sender, receiver, subject, and timestamps.

Computer.name: Mail.ru
Computer.description: Mail.ru is a webmail provider.

Computer.name: Mail.ru Chat Parsed
Computer.description: Mail.ru is a desktop communication application.

Computer.name: Mail.ru Contacts
Computer.description: Mail.ru is a desktop communication application.

Computer.name: Mail.ru Groups
Computer.description: Mail.ru is a desktop communication application.

Computer.name: Mailinator Inbox Access
Computer.description: Mailinator Inbox Access contains instances when a user accesess their Mailinator inbox. Mailinator is webmail service that allows users to send and receive emails anonymously.

Computer.name: Mailinator Snippets
Computer.description: Mailinator Snippets contains fragments of email messages that are sent using Mailinator. Mailinator is webmail service that allows users to send and receive emails anonymously.

Computer.name: MBOX Emails
Computer.description: MBOX is the default format used in Linux mail clients such as Thunderbird.

Computer.name: Offline Gmail
Computer.description: Gmail is a webmail website that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: Outlook 11 Calendar
Computer.description: Microsft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. Outlook 11 is the newest Chromium based version of Outlook for Windows 11. This table captures information related to emails sent and received in Outlook about meeting/calendar invites.

Computer.name: Outlook 11 Contacts
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. Outlook 11 is the newest Chromium based version of Outlook for Windows 11. This table captures information related to contacts stored in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook 11 Emails
Computer.description: Microsft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. Outlook 11 is the newest Chromium based version of Outlook for Windows 11. This table captures information related to emails sent and received in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook 11 Notes
Computer.description: Microsft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. Outlook 11 is the newest Chromium based version of Outlook for Windows 11. This table captures information related to notes written and stored in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook 11 To Do
Computer.description: Microsft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. Outlook 11 is the newest Chromium based version of Outlook for Windows 11. This table captures information related to tasks created in Outlook To Do feature.

Computer.name: Outlook Appointments
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to appointments scheduled in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook Contacts
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to contacts stored in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook Emails
Computer.description: Microsft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to emails sent and received in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook Journals
Computer.description: Microsft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client from Microsoft. This table captures information related to journal entries stored in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook Notes
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to notes written and stored in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook Tasks
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to tasks created in Outlook.

Computer.name: Outlook Web App Email Fragments
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to emails sent and received from Outlook's web application.

Computer.name: Outlook Web App Email Inbox
Computer.description: Microsoft Outlook is a personal information manager and email client. This table captures information related to the inbox viewed from Outlook's web application.

Computer.name: Outlook Webmail Fragments
Computer.description: Outlook.com (formerly hotmail.com) is a webmail website that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: Outlook Webmail Inbox
Computer.description: Outlook.com (formerly hotmail.com) is a webmail website that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: Outlook Webmail Inbox Fragments
Computer.description: Outlook.com (formerly hotmail.com) is a webmail website that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: Windows Mail
Computer.description: Windows Mail contains email messages sent or received using Windows Mail.

Computer.name: Yahoo! Webmail
Computer.description: Yahoo Mail is a web-based email client that allows users to send and receive emails.

Computer.name: Encrypted Files
Computer.description: Encrypted Files contains information about any files that have been recovered on the system that are encrypted. This artifact is not available in Magnet IEF.

Computer.name: Encryption / Anti-forensics Tools
Computer.description: Encryption/Anti-forensics Tools contains the encryption or anti-forensics tool(s) that have been found in the searched evidence.

Computer.name: Windows Stored Credentials
Computer.description: Windows Stored Credentials recover and decrypt the stored credentials for Windows Users. At this time, only non-domain users are supported.

Computer.name: Google Maps
Computer.description: Google Maps is a free web service that allows users to get directions.

Computer.name: Google Maps Tiles
Computer.description: Google maps is a free web service that allows users to get directions.

Computer.name: AMR Files
Computer.description: AMR Files contains voicemail messages or memos for both iOS and Android.

Computer.name: Audio
Computer.description: Audio contains audio files that are recovered that use the .mp3 or .wav formats.

Computer.name: Carved Video
Computer.description: Carved Video contains videos that are recovered using carving. Supported formats include AVI, MP4, DIVX, A3GP, M4A, QT, and WEBM. Other container formats can also be recovered provided that their underlying packets are the same as one of the supported formats.

Computer.name: Pictures
Computer.description: Pictures contains pictures retrieved using either carving or parsing techniques.

Computer.name: RealPlayer Library Assets
Computer.description: RealPlayer Library Assets contains information about the items that have been added to the library. This artifact can reveal information about the user's interaction with the application.

Computer.name: RealPlayer Video History
Computer.description: RealPlayer Video History contains information about the media files that were played using RealPlayer. This artifact can reveal information about the user's interaction with the application.

Computer.name: Videos
Computer.description: Videos contains videos that are recovered using parsing or carving. Supported formats for parsing include AVI, MP4, MOV, MPEG, DIVX, A3GP, ASF, WMV, DVR-MS, MKV, VOB, MOD, and WEBM. Supported carving formats include AVI, MP4, DIVX, A3GP, M4A, QT, and WEBM. For more information about supported video formats, see Supported media and file types.

Computer.name: VLC Recently Played Files
Computer.description: VLC Recently Played Files contains information about the media files that are played using the VLC Media Player. This artifact can reveal information on the user's interaction with the application.

Computer.name: Web Video Fragments
Computer.description: This search recovers two distinct types of web-based video. Fragments of Flash video can be left behind by many video streaming sites, such as YouTube. RTMP Frame Fragments are frames left behind by streaming sites using the RTMP protocol (widely used by webcam chat sites, including Chatroulette and Camstumble). In this case, a thumbnail from a recovered video is displayed, as well as any relevant metadata. Videos can be exported to .FLV format to be played. Due to the nature of the data recovered, some video players will have issues playing the exported files. We recommend trying FFmpeg, VLC, and the GOM player.

Computer.name: Active Network Info (sockets)
Computer.description: The Active Network Info (sockets) artifact can be used to detect listening sockets and identify active networks. For more information about the sockets utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#sockets.

Computer.name: API Hooks (apihooks)
Computer.description: The API Hooks (apihooks) artifact detects various styles of programming hooks. For more information about the apihooks utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference-Mal#apihooks.

Computer.name: Clipboard (clipboard)
Computer.description: The Clipboard (clipboard) artifact recovers data that the user saves to their clipboard. For more information about the clipboard utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference-Gui#clipboard.

Computer.name: Command History (cmdscan)
Computer.description: The Command History (cmdscan) artifact returns a history of commands that are run in the Command Prompt (cmd.exe). These results can help provide insight into an attack on the system. For more information about the cmdscan utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#cmdscan.

Computer.name: Connection Scan (connscan)
Computer.description: The Connection Scan (connscan) artifact contains information about network connections, both active and terminated. For more information about the connscan utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#connscan.

Computer.name: Dynamically Loaded Libraries (dlllist)
Computer.description: The Dynamically Loaded Libraries (dlllist) artifact contains information about the files that were loaded into memory. For more information about the dlllist utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#dlllist.

Computer.name: Files (filescan)
Computer.description: The Files (filescan) artifact contains information about the files that were loaded into memory. For more information about the psxview utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#filescan.

Computer.name: Hidden Processes (psxview)
Computer.description: The Hidden Processes (psxview) artifact can help reveal processes that were hidden. For more information about the psxview utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference-Mal#psxview.

Computer.name: Hidden/Residual Modules (modscan)
Computer.description: The Hidden/Residual Modules (modscan) artifact scans memory for pool tags to reveal unloaded drivers or drivers that have been hidden/unlinked by rootkits. For more information about the modscan utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#modscan.

Computer.name: Hidden/Terminated Processes (psscan)
Computer.description: The Hidden/Terminated Processes (psscan) artifact can help reveal processes that were terminated or were hidden or unlinked by a rootkit. For more information about the psscan utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#psscan.

Computer.name: Image Info (imageinfo)
Computer.description: The Image Info (imageinfo) artifact reveals high-level information about the memory image being scanned. For more information about the imageinfo utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#imageinfo.

Computer.name: LDR Modules (ldrmodules)
Computer.description: The LDR Modules (ldrmodules) artifact can help reveal DLLs that have been hidden with malicious intent. For more information about the ldrmodules utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference-Mal#ldrmodules.

Computer.name: Loaded Kernel Modules (modules)
Computer.description: The Loaded Kernel Modules (modules) artifact shows the kernel drivers that are loaded on the system. For more information about the modules utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#modules.

Computer.name: Malware Finder (malfind)
Computer.description: The Malware Finder (malfind) artifact can help reveal hidden or injected code/DLLs in memory. For more information about the malfind utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference-Mal#malfind.

Computer.name: Network Connections (connections)
Computer.description: The Network Connections (connections) artifact can be used to recover information about active TCP connections. For more information about the connections utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#connections.

Computer.name: Network Connections (sockscan)
Computer.description: The Network Connections (sockscan) artifact can be used to detect sockets used in network connections. For more information about the sockscan utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#sockscan.

Computer.name: Network Info (netscan)
Computer.description: The Network Info (netscan) artifact can be used to recover network details from memory, such as TCP or UDP listeners and endpoints. For more information about the netscan utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#netscan.

Computer.name: Open Handles (handles)
Computer.description: The Open Handles (handles) artifact can be used to show the active handles in a process. For more information about the handles utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#handles.

Computer.name: Process Security Identifiers (getsids)
Computer.description: The Process Security Identifiers (getsids) artifact can be used to recover the SIDs (security identifiers) associated with a process. SIDs can be useful in identifying processes that have their privileges escalated with malicious intent. For more information about the getsids utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#getsids.

Computer.name: Processes (pslist)
Computer.description: The Processes (pslist) artifact contains information about the processes that are loaded into memory. For more information about the pslist utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#pslist.

Computer.name: Timeline (timeliner)
Computer.description: The Timeline (timeliner) artifact scans a number of different sources in memory, such as processes, event logs, threads, and registry keys, and creates hits to help illustrate a timeline of the events. For more information about the timeliner utility, see https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#timeliner.

Computer.name: $LogFile Analysis
Computer.description: $LogFile Analysis provides a sequence analysis of the $LogFile data, condensing the data to draw definitive conclusions on file operations (i.e. file creation, deletion, moving, renaming, and writing).

Computer.name: .DS_Store Records
Computer.description: .DS_Store Records contains all the records extracted from .DS_Store files found on the computer. Each record represents a property of a file or a folder. The significance of this artifact is an indicator of high likelihood that the user of the computer was aware of these files and folders with a possibility of attributing a date to that awareness.

Computer.name: AmCache Device Containers
Computer.description: AmCache Device Containers contains information recovered from the AmCache about the devices that are connected to the system, such as printers, Bluetooth devices, and storage devices.

Computer.name: AmCache Driver Binaries
Computer.description: AmCache Driver Binaries contains information recovered from the AmCache about driver binaries on the system. These records can contain information about when a driver is signed, the company associated with the driver, and what service it is associated with.

Computer.name: AmCache Driver Packages
Computer.description: AmCache Driver Packages contains information recovered from the AmCache about driver packages on the system.

Computer.name: AmCache File Entries
Computer.description: AmCache File Entries contains information recovered from the AmCache about files that are used by executable programs.

Computer.name: AmCache File Entries - Legacy
Computer.description: AmCache File Entries contains information recovered from the AmCache about files that are used by executable programs. This version of the artifact is for the older, legacy version of the AmCache.

Computer.name: AmCache Pnp Devices
Computer.description: AmCache Pnp Devices contains information recovered from the AmCache about plug-n-play devices connected to the system.

Computer.name: AmCache Program Entries
Computer.description: AmCache Program Entries contains information recovered from the AmCache about the applications that are run on the system.

Computer.name: AmCache Program Entries - Legacy
Computer.description: AmCache Program Entries contains information recovered from the AmCache about the applications that are run on the system. This version of the artifact is for the older, legacy version of the AmCache.

Computer.name: AmCache Shortcuts
Computer.description: AmCache Shortcuts contains information recovered from the AmCache about applications and file shortcuts are that are used on the system.

Computer.name: AutoRun Items
Computer.description: The Autorun Items artifact describes the programs that are configured to run automatically when a certain system event occurs.

Computer.name: Cortana Person Reminders
Computer.description: Cortana Person Reminders are reminders that can be set for a specific contact. Cortana triggers the reminders when an interaction with that contact occurs, such as when an email is received.

Computer.name: Cortana Place Reminders
Computer.description: Cortana Place Reminders are virtual areas that you can define in Cortana to represent a real geographic place. Entering or leaving an area can trigger Cortana to display the reminder.

Computer.name: Cortana Time Reminders
Computer.description: Cortana Time Reminders are reminders that can be set for a specific time.

Computer.name: Default Browser
Computer.description: This table contains information about the default browser that is set on a computer.

Computer.name: File Associations
Computer.description: File Associations contais information about application associations for files. Users or applications can set associations for file types so that when a file of a specified file type is opened, a command gets triggered by Windows.

Computer.name: File System Information
Computer.description: Information pertaining to the File System that was searched

Computer.name: IME Suggestions (Japanese)
Computer.description: IME Suggestions (Japanese) contains Japanese characters that have been suggested to the user as they use the Input Method Entry (IME) feature in Windows. This feature allows a user to provide a Unicode string and returns the equivalent Japanese characters as a suggestion.

Computer.name: IME Suggestions - Google Japanese Input
Computer.description: IME Suggestions - Google Japanese Input contains strings that have been suggested to the user as they use Google Japanese Input as the Input Method Entry (IME) on Windows. This feature allows a user to provide a Unicode string and returns the equivalent characters as a suggestion.

Computer.name: Jump Lists
Computer.description: Jump lists are quick lists of recent applications or files that a user launched. The Dest List entries and shortcut entries are combined into a single table showing their joined structure.

Computer.name: Keyword Searches
Computer.description: A list of keywords that were searched for on the system.

Computer.name: Known DLLs
Computer.description: Known DLLs is a list of DLLs that have been cached by Windows and are known to be safe. The DLLs are assumed to be located at either the folder path found in DLL Directory or DLL Directory32. The list of Known DLLs can be found at the following registry location: SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\KnownDlls.

Computer.name: LNK Files
Computer.description: LNK files are Windows shortcut files that point to other files on the system.

Computer.name: MRU Folder Access
Computer.description: The MRU Folder Access artifact contains information about the folders that are accessed by a Windows application using Open/Save browsing dialogs. Windows versions above XP use PIDL to store file path. PIDL paths might contain GUIDs instead of relative path strings. Folder access data cis recovered from the following registry location: Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\ComDlg32\LastVisitedPidlMRU (LastVisitedMRU for Windows XP).

Computer.name: MRU Opened/Saved Files
Computer.description: MRU Opened/Saved Files contains information about last files accessed by any application through 'Open File' or 'Save File' dialog window. Windows versions above XP use PIDL to store file path. PIDL paths might contain GUIDs instead of relative path strings. Opened/Saved files data can be found at the following registry location: Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\ComDlg32\OpenSavePidlMRU\<subkey> (OpenSaveMRU for Windows XP).

Computer.name: MRU Recent Files And Folders
Computer.description: The MRU Recent Files And Folders artifact contains information about files that were recently opened or saved and folders that were opened. This data is often related to items found in the Recent folder in the Users directory. Recent files and folders data is recovered from the following registry location: Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\RecentDocs.

Computer.name: MRU Run Commands
Computer.description: The MRU Run Commands artifact contains information about commands that a user runs using the Run utility for Windows. Run command data is recovered from the following registry location: Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\RunMRU.

Computer.name: MUICache
Computer.description: The MUICache artifact contains information about the files that are executed on the system, as parsed from the MUICache registry key.

Computer.name: Network Interfaces (Registry)
Computer.description: Network Interfaces (Registry) contains a list of all of the network interfaces that the image has stored in the registry.

Computer.name: Network Profiles
Computer.description: A list of the saved Network Profiles on a machine.

Computer.name: Network Share Information
Computer.description: Network Share Information provides information about mapped network drives on Windows.

Computer.name: Network Usage - Application Data
Computer.description: Network Usage Application Data contains information about how an application sends or receives data over the network.

Computer.name: Network Usage - Connections
Computer.description: Network Usage Connections contains information about the networks that a device connects to.

Computer.name: NTFS Timestamp Mismatch
Computer.description: NTFS Timestamp Mismatch reports on files where timestamps may have been modified externally. This artifact checks for cases where the $STANDARD_INFORMATION timestamps are older than the equivalent $FILE_NAME timestamps. It also checks for timestamps that have milliseconds set to 0, which may indicate timestomping with an external tool. For an artifact hit to be produced, the created, modified, and MFT modified times all have to be mismatched or have zero milliseconds.

Computer.name: Operating System Information
Computer.description: This table provides information about the Windows installation.

Computer.name: PowerShell History
Computer.description: The PowerShell History artifact contains a history of PowerShell commands executed on the system.

Computer.name: Prefetch Files - Windows 8/10/11
Computer.description: Prefetch files are used to speed up launching of frequently used executables. This table is for Windows 8 and 10.

Computer.name: Prefetch Files - Windows XP/Vista/7
Computer.description: Prefetch files are used to speed up launching of frequently used executables. This table is for versions of Windows XP, Vista and 7.

Computer.name: Program Compatibility Assistant Records
Computer.description: Program Compatibility Assistant Records is an artifact that allows users to view a program's execution information.

Computer.name: Rebuilt Desktops - Windows
Computer.description: Rebuilt Desktops is an artifact that allows users to view an approximation of what a given Windows user's desktop looks like, including wallpapers, monitor configurations, and icon positioning, without having to virtualize the image.

Computer.name: Recycle Bin
Computer.description: Recycle Bin displays all items that were moved to the Recycle Bin.

Computer.name: Scheduled Tasks
Computer.description: The Scheduled Tasks artifact contains information about the scheduled tasks that are recovered from the computer. These records can be important to incident response investigations as malware often uses Scheduled Tasks to persist their content on an infected system.

Computer.name: Shellbags
Computer.description: Windows Shellbags track folder access by keeping logs of the view mode of a folder. If a shellbag record exists for a path, it has been previously viewed.

Computer.name: Shim Cache
Computer.description: The Shim Cache is used by Windows to track statistics about executables, such as the file path, size, and execution time (varies depending on the version of Windows). Only certain types of executable files are tracked and the data is only as recent as the last system reboot

Computer.name: SRUM Application Resource Usage
Computer.description: The SRUM Application Resource Usage artifact tracks information about an application's resource usage. This artifact indicates the number of CPU cycles an application uses, context switches (foreground to background), and information about input and output operations.

Computer.name: SRUM Energy Usage
Computer.description: The SRUM Energy Usage artifact contains information about the power expenditure for a device, as recovered from the SRUM database.

Computer.name: SRUM Energy Usage (Long Term)
Computer.description: The SRUM Energy Usage (Long Term) artifact contains information about the power expenditure for a device, as recovered from the SRUM database.

Computer.name: SRUM Network Connections
