iOS.description: iOS App Cache contains a cache of web content from various applications on an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS Call Logs - Biome App Intents
iOS.description: iOS Call Logs - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the iOS phone application.

iOS.name: iOS Device Information
iOS.description: iOS Device Information contains information about the physical device, such as model information, the software version, timezone information, and the IMEI.

iOS.name: iOS iMessage/SMS/MMS - Biome App Intents
iOS.description: iMessage/SMS/MMS - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the iOS Messages app related to sent and received messages.

iOS.name: iOS Spotlight
iOS.description: iOS Spotlight contains the iMessage/SMS/MMS messages that have been saved by the Spotlight application.

iOS.name: iOS User Shortcut Dictionary
iOS.description: iOS User Shortcut Dictionary contains the shortcuts and phrases that a user has on their device.

iOS.name: iOS User Word Dictionary
iOS.description: iOS User Word Dictionary contains the words that a user has typed on the device.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Activity Level
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Activity Level provides information about the KnowledgeC stream type of activity level.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Application Activities
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Application Activities contains information about activities associated with specific applications.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Application Focus
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Application Focus provides information about the applications that were in focus on the device screen, within a recorded interval.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Application Install States
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Application Install States provides information about when applications were installed or uninstalled on the device.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Application Intents
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Application Intents bring additional context and detail to user interactions with the device. Application Intents are recorded by the system and are not always initiated by user interaction. For example, an intent is recorded when the user initiates a call and also when a call is received but isn't answered.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Application Usage
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Application Usage provides information about the applications that were used on the device, within a recorded interval.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Application Web Usage
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Application Web Usage provides information about the applications that were used to access webpages on a iOS device, within a recorded interval.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Device Lock States
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Device Lock States provides information about whether the device is locked or unlocked within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Device Orientation States
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Device Orientation States provides information about the orientation of the device within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Device Plugged-in States
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Device Plugged-in States provides information about the plugged-in state of a device within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time. Knowing when a device is connected to a charger or a computer using a USB can help to identify how the device is used.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Do Not Disturb Usage
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Do Not Disturb Usage contains system activity information for the Do Not Disturb setting on the device.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Keybag Lock States
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Keybag Lock States provides information about whether the device's keybag is locked or unlocked within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Media History
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Media History provides information about what type of audio or video media that the user was engaging with at what time, as recovered from knowledgeC.db

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Notification Usage
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Activity Level provides information about the KnowledgeC stream type of activity level.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Safari History
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Safari History provides information about webpages that were accessed using the Safari browser, as recovered from knowledgeC.db

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Screen Backlight States
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Screen Backlight States provides information about the device backlight within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time. This information can help identify whether a device was in active use within a specific interval.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Siri Intents
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Siri Intents contains information about Siri interactions with the user's device.

iOS.name: KnowledgeC Siri UI Usage
iOS.description: KnowledgeC Siri UI Usage contains logs of the time windows that the Siri UI is in use.

iOS.name: Screen Time Application Usage
iOS.description: Screen Time Application Usage contains usage and notification information for all applications tracked by Screen Time. The application (and this artifact) tracks data in 60 minute intervals, so any usage and notification data applies only to that segment of time. This artifact can help identify when an application was in use and for how long, both on the local device and other devices that are synced under the same Apple ID/Family Account.

iOS.name: Screen Time Synced Applications
iOS.description: Screen Time Synced Applications contains list of all the applications that are being tracked using Screen Time. This list includes applications that are installed on the local user's device, or are installed on other devices connected to the same family account or use the same Apple ID.

iOS.name: Signal - Biome App Intents
iOS.description: Signal - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the Signal app related to sent and received messages and calls.

iOS.name: Siri - Biome App Intents
iOS.description: Siri - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from Siri related to the use of Siri and interactions with other applications.

iOS.name: Snapchat - Biome App Intents
iOS.description: Snapchat - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the Snapchat app related to sent and received messages.

iOS.name: Spotlight Searches
iOS.description: Spotlight Searches contains the keyword search terms that a user has entered in the Spotlight feature on iOS.

iOS.name: Wallet Passes
iOS.description: Wallet Passes contains information on passes (boarding passes, coupons, event tickets, store cards, and others) that have been saved to the user's Apple Wallet application.

iOS.name: Wallet Payment Cards
iOS.description: Wallet Payment Cards contains information on payment cards that have been saved to the user's Apple Wallet application.

iOS.name: Wallet Transactions
iOS.description: Wallet Transactions contains information about transactions that have been completed with the Apple Wallet application. This artifact can also recover transactions with cards that are associated with the wallet but aren't made through the Apple Wallet application.

iOS.name: Weather - Biome App Intents
iOS.description: Weather - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the Weather app related to location.

iOS.name: WhatsApp Biome App Intents - iOS
iOS.description: WhatsApp Biome App Intents - iOS contains information about application intents from the WhatsApp app related to sent and received messages and calls.

iOS.name: Google Drive Items
iOS.description: Google Drive Items contains information about the documents, folders and media that have been accessed using Google Drive on the device.

iOS.name: Google Drive Thumbnails
iOS.description: Google Drive Thumbnails contains information about thumbnail pictures of the Google Drive items found on the device.

iOS.name: iCloud Devices
iOS.description: iCloud Devices show a list of devices that have access to the iCloud.

iOS.name: iCloud Downloads
iOS.description: iCloud Downloads show a list of files that have been either recently downloaded or are pending download.

iOS.name: iCloud Local Files
iOS.description: iCloud Local Files are files that have been imported from the local computer or synced remotely from the iCloud Drive folder on a iOS machine.

iOS.name: iCloud Server Files
iOS.description: iCloud Server Files are files that exist on the iCloud server, and may not exist on the local iOS machine.

iOS.name: iCloud Uploads
iOS.description: iCloud Uploads show a list of files that have been either recently uploaded or are pending upload.

iOS.name: iOS Dropbox
iOS.description: iOS Dropbox contains information from the iOS Dropbox Database regarding the cached files.

iOS.name: MEGA Accounts
iOS.description: MEGA Accounts contains information about the accounts that the local user has logged in with on the device.

iOS.name: MEGA Chat
iOS.description: MEGA Chat contains messages sent and received by the local user.

iOS.name: MEGA Contacts
iOS.description: MEGA Contacts contains information about MEGA users that have communicated with the local user account.

iOS.name: AIM Buddies
iOS.description: AIM Buddies contains information about the local user's buddies in the iOS AIM application.

iOS.name: AIM Messages
iOS.description: AIM Messages contains messages that were sent and received from the iOS AIM application.

iOS.name: Apple Contacts - iOS
iOS.description: Apple Contacts contains information about the contacts that a user has saved to their device.

iOS.name: BlackBerry Messenger Contacts
iOS.description: BlackBerry Messenger Contacts contains the BBM Contacts recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: BlackBerry Messenger File Transfers
iOS.description: BlackBerry Messenger File Transfers contains the BBM File Transfers recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: BlackBerry Messenger Invitations
iOS.description: BlackBerry Messenger Invitations contains the BBM invite requests recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: BlackBerry Messenger Locations
iOS.description: BlackBerry Messenger Locations contains the BBM locations recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: BlackBerry Messenger Messages
iOS.description: BlackBerry Messenger Messages contains the BBM messages recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: BlackBerry Messenger Profile
iOS.description: BlackBerry Messenger Profile contains the BBM Profiles recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: Burner Contacts
iOS.description: Burner Contacts contains information about a subject's Burner Contacts, as recovered from their iOS device.

iOS.name: Burner Messages
iOS.description: Burner Messages contains information about messages and calls that are sent and received using Burner.

iOS.name: Burner Numbers
iOS.description: Burner Numbers contains information about the burner numbers that the local user created.

iOS.name: Chatous Chat Messages
iOS.description: Chatous Chat Messages contains messages sent and received using Chatous.

iOS.name: Chatous Chat Partners
iOS.description: Chatous Chat Partners contains information about the users that the local user has communicated with.

iOS.name: Discord Messages
iOS.description: Discord Messages contains information about messages and calls that are sent and received using Discord. Messages from some channels might be missing if they haven't been cached by the application. This artifact uses both parsing and carving techniques to recover messages.

iOS.name: Facebook Messenger Calls
iOS.description: Facebook Messenger Calls contains call data recovered from Facebook Messenger. Provides useful background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with. Status and location updates in social media can also provide location information about them.

iOS.name: Facebook Messenger End-to-End Encrypted Chats
iOS.description: Facebook Messenger End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) Chats contains messages recovered from Facebook Messenger E2EE chats on the device.

iOS.name: Facebook Messenger Groups
iOS.description: Facebook Messenger Groups contains data about group chats on Facebook Messenger. Provides useful background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with. Status and location updates in social media can also provide location information about them.

iOS.name: Facebook Messenger Messages
iOS.description: Facebook Messenger Messages contains messages recovered from Facebook Messenger. Provides useful background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with. Status and location updates in social media can also provide location information about them.

iOS.name: Facebook Messenger Users Contacted
iOS.description: Facebook Messenger Users Contacted contains information about users contacted from the device using Facebook Messenger. Status and location updates in social media can provide detail on where the user has been. In addition, this artifact provides background information on the user, including who they are communicating or associated with.

iOS.name: Glide Messages
iOS.description: Glide Messages contains messages sent and received by the local user.

iOS.name: Glide Users
iOS.description: Glide Users contains information about the various users that the device owner has encountered using Glide.

iOS.name: Google Duo Accounts
iOS.description: Google Duo contains information about the first time a user logged into Google Duo.

iOS.name: Google Duo Activity
iOS.description: Google Duo Activity contains details about audio calls, video calls, and messages sent and received by the user.

iOS.name: Google Duo Group Calls
iOS.description: Google Duo Group Calls contains details about the video calls made and received by the user.

iOS.name: Google Duo Groups
iOS.description: Google Duo Groups contains membership information of Google Duo Groups.

iOS.name: Google Duo Users
iOS.description: Google Duo Users contains details about the user's contacts. Google Duo stores both contacts that are already signed up with Duo as well as contacts from the user's address book that can be invited to Duo.

iOS.name: Google Hangouts Voice Calls
iOS.description: Google Hangouts Voice Calls contains a history of voice calls between the local user and other users.

iOS.name: Google Meet Meeting History - iOS
iOS.description: Google Meet Meeting History contains the meetings that any local user on the device has joined.

iOS.name: GroupMe Accounts
iOS.description: GroupMe Accounts contains information about the accounts that the local user has logged in with on the device.

iOS.name: GroupMe Contacts
iOS.description: GroupMe Contacts contains information about a user's contacts.

iOS.name: GroupMe Groups
iOS.description: GroupMe Groups contains information about the groups that the logged-in user is a member of.

iOS.name: GroupMe Messages
iOS.description: GroupMe Messages contains messages sent and received using GroupMe.

iOS.name: Houseparty Messages
iOS.description: Houseparty Messages contains messages recovered from Houseparty.

iOS.name: Houseparty Users
iOS.description: Houseparty Users contains information about the users contacted from the device using Houseparty.

iOS.name: imo Contacts
iOS.description: imo Contacts contains information about a user's contacts.

iOS.name: imo Messages
iOS.description: imo Messages contains information about sent and received messages and calls made using the imo application.

iOS.name: iOS Burner Conversations
iOS.description: iOS Burner Conversations contains the Burner conversations that were recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS Burner Numbers
iOS.description: iOS Burner Numbers contains the Burner numbers that were recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS Call Logs
iOS.description: iOS Call Logs contains iOS Call Logs from the iOS native phone application.

iOS.name: iOS Google Hangouts Cached Images
iOS.description: iOS Google Hangouts Cached Images contains the cached images from Google Hangouts from an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS Google Hangouts Contacts
iOS.description: iOS Google Hangouts Contacts contains the contacts of a person from Google Hangouts from an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS Google Hangouts Messages
iOS.description: iOS Google Hangouts Messages contains the messages from Google Hangouts from an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS iMessage/SMS/MMS
iOS.description: iOS iMessage/SMS/MMS contains all of the iMessage, SMS, MMS and RCS messages sent or received by the user.

iOS.name: iOS iMessage/SMS/MMS - App Intents
iOS.description: iOS iMessage/SMS/MMS - App Intents contains information about application intents from the iOS Messages app related to sent and received messages.

iOS.name: iOS Kik Messenger Attachments
iOS.description: iOS Kik Messenger Attachments contains the attachments of messages from Kik Messenger from an iOS device.

iOS.name: iOS Kik Messenger Messages
iOS.description: iOS Kik Messenger Messages contains Kik Messenger messages that were sent or received by the local user.

iOS.name: iOS Kik Messenger Users
iOS.description: iOS Kik Messenger Users contains information about a user's Kik Messenger contacts.

iOS.name: iOS Messages Local Accounts
iOS.description: iOS Messages Local Accounts contains information about account used in iOS Messages app.

iOS.name: iOS Messages Preferences
iOS.description: iOS Messages Preferences contains information about important settings of the Messages application.

iOS.name: iOS Textfree Cache Records
iOS.description: iOS Textfree Cache Records contains the web cache for the iOS Textfree application.

iOS.name: iOS TextNow Contacts
iOS.description: TextNow Contacts contains the application, phone, email, and group contacts that a user has in the TextNow application.

iOS.name: iOS TextNow Groups
iOS.description: TextNow Groups contains membership information for TextNow group chats.

iOS.name: iOS TigerText Messages
iOS.description: iOS TigerText Messages contains sent and received messages with attachments from iOS TigerText application.

iOS.name: iOS Voice Mail
iOS.description: iOS Voice Mail contains messages left on the voicemail for the iOS device, along with any greetings messages recorded by the local user. This includes audio or video voicemail messages left using FaceTime.

iOS.name: IP Addresses - Audio/Video Calls
iOS.description: IP Addresses of web audio/video calls show who a user was communicating with. Each instance of this artifact represents a single hop in the communication chain. By showing the relationship between multiple hops, you can determine where a call originated from and what the final destination was.

iOS.name: KakaoTalk Messages - iOS
iOS.description: KakaoTalk Messages contains messages that are sent or received by the user.

iOS.name: LINE Contacts
iOS.description: LINE Contacts contains the user's LINE contacts.

iOS.name: LINE Groups
iOS.description: LINE Groups contains the information from the groups that the local user is a part of.

iOS.name: LINE Local Users
iOS.description: LINE Local Users contains the local user accounts for LINE on the device.

iOS.name: LINE Messages
iOS.description: LINE Messages contains the LINE messages that were recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: LINE Pictures
iOS.description: LINE Pictures contains the LINE pictures that were recovered from an iOS device.

iOS.name: Mail.Ru Agent Contacts
iOS.description: Mail.Ru Agent Contacts contains contact info for the Agent application on iOS.

iOS.name: Mail.Ru Agent Messages
iOS.description: Mail.Ru Agent Messages contains messages sent or received by the Agent user on iOS.

iOS.name: Mail.Ru Agent User Accounts
iOS.description: Mail.Ru Agent User Accounts contains information about the Agent user accounts that are saved locally on the iOS device.

iOS.name: Microsoft Teams Accounts
iOS.description: Microsoft Teams Accounts contains information about the Microsoft accounts used to authenticate to Microsoft Teams on an iOS device. The account details can help investigators identify active users, correlate account information across Microsoft Teams artifacts, and provide context for messages and other activities associated with specific accounts.

iOS.name: Microsoft Teams Activity
iOS.description: Microsoft Teams Activity contains interactions that occur between users on Microsoft Teams. These interactions include messages, members added/removed from meetings, and meeting start/end events.

iOS.name: Microsoft Teams Calendar
iOS.description: Microsoft Teams Calendar contains a record of all upcoming and past calendar events that use Microsoft Teams. Offline meetings are not included.

iOS.name: Microsoft Teams Calls
iOS.description: Microsoft Teams Calls contains call logs that occurred between users on Microsoft Teams. The Call ID can be used with Microsoft Teams Messages to view additional information about the call.

iOS.name: Microsoft Teams Conversations
iOS.description: Microsoft Teams Conversations contains a summary of the last message details (sender, time, and content) and registered participants in the local user's chat or meeting conversations on Microsoft Teams.

iOS.name: Microsoft Teams Messages
iOS.description: Microsoft Teams Messages contains interactions that occur between users on Microsoft Teams. These interactions include messages, meeting calls, members added/removed from meetings, and meeting start/end events. The Call ID can be used with Microsoft Teams Calls to view additional information about call events.

iOS.name: ooVoo Chat History
iOS.description: ooVoo Chat History contains the chat history between the data owner and their contacts.

iOS.name: ooVoo Contact List
iOS.description: ooVoo Contact List contains the list of contacts that the data owner has on ooVoo.

iOS.name: ooVoo Phone Book
iOS.description: ooVoo Phone Book contains the name and phone number of contacts from the data owner's iOS device.

iOS.name: QQ File Transfers
iOS.description: QQ File Transfers contains QQ file transfers recovered from the iOS QQ International application.

iOS.name: QQ Local Users
iOS.description: QQ Local Users contains QQ local users recovered from the iOS QQ International application.

iOS.name: QQ Messages
iOS.description: QQ Messages contains messages stored by the iOS QQ International application.

iOS.name: QQ Messages Carved
iOS.description: QQ Messages Carved contains carved messages stored by the iOS QQ International application.

iOS.name: Session Communities
iOS.description: Session Communities contains information about the open session groups that the local user has joined.

iOS.name: Session Groups
iOS.description: Session Groups specifies each of the Session groups that the local user is a member of.

iOS.name: Session Messages
iOS.description: Session Messages contains information about the messages and calls that are exchanged between the local user and other users on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Session Users
iOS.description: Session Users contains information about the users the local user has associated with through communities, group chats, or direct messages.

iOS.name: Signal Group Members
iOS.description: Signal Group Members specifies the members from each of the Signal groups that the local user is a member of.

iOS.name: Signal Groups
iOS.description: Signal Groups contains information about group messages and the members of those groups

iOS.name: Signal Local User
iOS.description: Signal Local User contains information about the local user account.

iOS.name: Signal Messages - iOS
iOS.description: Signal Messages contains information about the messages and calls that are exchanged between the local user and other users on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Signal Stories
iOS.description: Signal Stories contains information about stories that are posted, viewed, or exchanged between the local user and other users on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Signal Users
iOS.description: Signal Users lists all the users and profiles present in the application. This artifact usually recovers user information for the local user, although it is not possible to indicate with certainty which user is the local user.

iOS.name: Skype Accounts
iOS.description: Skype Accounts contains information about the Skype accounts that are recovered, such as user information and when the account was created.

iOS.name: Skype Activity
iOS.description: Skype Activity contains interactions that occurred between users on Skype. These interactions include messages, message drafts, group interactions, calls, sent and recieved files, and SMS.

iOS.name: Skype Calls
iOS.description: Skype Calls contains information about Skype calls that occured between users.

iOS.name: Skype Chat Messages
iOS.description: Skype Chat messages contains Skype chat messages sent from one user to another.

iOS.name: Skype Chatsync Messages
iOS.description: Skype Chatsync Messages contains Skype messages sent from one user to another that are parsed from the chatsync directory.

iOS.name: Skype Contacts
iOS.description: Skype Contacts contains information about Skype contacts that are recovered, which may or may not be added contacts.

iOS.name: Skype Emotions
iOS.description: Skype Emotions contains reactions from users on Skype messages.

iOS.name: Skype File Transfers
iOS.description: Skype File Transfers contains files that are transferred from one user to another using Skype.

iOS.name: Skype Group Chat
iOS.description: Skype Group Chat contains information about the Skype group chats that a user is a part of.

iOS.name: Skype IP Addresses
iOS.description: Skype IP Addresses contains IP addresses that are associated with a Skype user account.

iOS.name: Skype Notifications
iOS.description: Skype Notifications contains notifications shown to users on Skype.

iOS.name: Skype SMS
iOS.description: Skype SMS contains SMS messages that a user sends or recieves using Skype.

iOS.name: Skype Voicemails
iOS.description: Skype Voicemails contains voicemails that a user sends or recieves using Skype.

iOS.name: Slack Accounts
iOS.description: Slack Accounts contains account information on accounts signed onto the local device.

iOS.name: Slack Channel Messages
iOS.description: Slack Channel Messages contains messages sent or received in channels in the user's Slack workspace.

iOS.name: Slack Channels
iOS.description: Slack Channels contains information about each of the channels and conversations that exist in a user's Slack workspace.

iOS.name: Slack Direct Messages
iOS.description: Slack Direct Messages contains information about direct messages sent or received in 1:1 chats or group chats.

iOS.name: Slack Files
iOS.description: Slack Files contains information about any files that have been saved to the Slack workspace. Files may or may not have been shared with other users.

iOS.name: Slack Users
iOS.description: Slack Users contains information about each user in the Slack workspace.

iOS.name: Snapchat Cached Videos
iOS.description: Snapchat Cached Videos contains videos stored by the Snapchat application on iOS

iOS.name: Snapchat Chat Messages
iOS.description: Snapchat Chat Messages contains the chat messages sent between users.

iOS.name: Snapchat Contacts
iOS.description: Snapchat Contacts contains information about the user's Snapchat friends as well as contact information from the user's device that was requested by the Snapchat application.

iOS.name: Snapchat Conversations - iOS
iOS.description: Snapchat Conversations - iOS contain information about all the chats recovered from the local device.

iOS.name: Snapchat Group Members
iOS.description: Snapchat Group Members contains information about participants of the groups that the local user is a member of.

iOS.name: Snapchat Memories
iOS.description: Snapchat Memories contains pictures and videos that the Snapchat user saves as a memory.

iOS.name: Snapchat My Story - iOS
iOS.description: Snapchat My Story - iOS contains information about a collection of Snaps which can exist for a 24 hour period.

iOS.name: Snapchat Segmented Videos
iOS.description: Snapchat Segmented Videos contains videos that may have been viewed by the user.

iOS.name: Snapchat Stories - iOS
iOS.description: Snapchat Stories contains information about a collection of snaps, which can exist for a 24 hour period.

iOS.name: Snapchat Story Snaps - iOS
iOS.description: Snapchat Story Snaps contains information about snaps that have been posted to a story.

iOS.name: TamTam Messenger Channels - iOS
iOS.description: TamTam Messenger Channels contains messages that belong to channel conversations recovered from the local device. The user must be subscribed to the channel in order to receive the messages.

iOS.name: TamTam Messenger Contacts - iOS
iOS.description: TamTam Messenger Contacts displays information about the TamTam contacts associated with the local user's account (including the local user).

iOS.name: TamTam Messenger Conversations - iOS
iOS.description: TamTam Messenger Conversations contains information about all chats recovered from the local device, including individual, group, channel and draft messages.

iOS.name: TamTam Messenger Groups - iOS
iOS.description: TamTam Messenger Groups contains all messages that belong to group conversations recovered from the local device.

iOS.name: TamTam Messenger Messages - iOS
iOS.description: TamTam Messenger Messages contains all individual messages (one-to-one) recovered from the local device.

iOS.name: Telegram Accounts
iOS.description: Telegram Accounts contains information about the Telegram accounts configured on the local device, including the local user details associated with each account. Telegram supports several accounts being signed into the local device. The active account column indicates which account is currently selected.

iOS.name: Telegram Channel Chats - iOS
iOS.description: iOS Telegram Channel Chats contains information about the channel chats that the user participates in using the Telegram application.

iOS.name: Telegram Chats - iOS
iOS.description: iOS Telegram Chats contains information about the chats that the user participates in using the Telegram application.

iOS.name: Telegram Groups - iOS
iOS.description: iOS Telegram Groups contains information about the groups that the user has participated in using the Telegram application.

iOS.name: Telegram Messages - iOS
iOS.description: iOS Telegram Messages contains individual chat messages that are sent and received using the Telegram application.

iOS.name: Telegram Users - iOS
iOS.description: iOS Telegram Users contains information about the various users that the device owner has encountered using Telegram, either directly or as part of a channel chat.

iOS.name: TeleGuard Accounts Information
iOS.description: TeleGuard Accounts Information contains information about the account that the user has logged in with on the device.

iOS.name: TeleGuard Channels
iOS.description: TeleGuard Channels contains information about each of the channels subscribed to or created by the local user account.

iOS.name: TeleGuard Contacts
iOS.description: TeleGuard Users contains information about a user's TeleGuard contacts.

iOS.name: TeleGuard Groups
iOS.description: TeleGuard Groups contains information about a user's TeleGuard groups.

iOS.name: TeleGuard Messages
iOS.description: TeleGuard Messages contains information about the messages sent and received by the user.

iOS.name: TeleGuard Posts
iOS.description: TeleGuard Posts contains information about the posts that were published in the channels the user subscribed to or created.

iOS.name: Textfree Attachments
iOS.description: Textfree Attachments contains attachments from the iOS Textfree application.

iOS.name: Textfree Contacts
iOS.description: Textfree Contacts contains the contacts from the iOS Textfree application.

iOS.name: Textfree Groups
iOS.description: Textfree Groups contains information about group chats from the iOS Textfree applications.

iOS.name: Textfree Messages / Calls
iOS.description: Textfree Messages contains messages from the iOS Textfree application.

iOS.name: TextMe Calls
iOS.description: TextMe Calls contains information about the calls that the user participates in using the TextMe application.

iOS.name: TextMe Conversations
iOS.description: TextMe Conversations contains details about all the conversations the local user is a part of.

iOS.name: TextMe Messages
iOS.description: TextMe Messages contains individual chat messages that are sent and received using the TextMe application.

iOS.name: TextNow Calls
iOS.description: TextNow Calls contains information about calls and voicemails that are sent and received through the TextNow applications.

iOS.name: TextNow Chat
iOS.description: TextNow Chat contains chat messages that are sent and received through the TextNow application.

iOS.name: TextNow Profile
iOS.description: TextNow Profile contains the TextNow user's profile and application preference settings.

iOS.name: TextPlus Calls
iOS.description: TextPlus Calls contains call information from TextPlus data on an iOS device.

iOS.name: TextPlus Messages
iOS.description: TextPlus Messages contains message information from TextPlus data on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Threema Messages
iOS.description: Threema Messages contains messages sent and received by the local Threema user.

iOS.name: Threema Users
iOS.description: Threema Users contains information about the various users that the device owner has encountered using Threema.

iOS.name: Viber Messages
iOS.description: Viber Messages contains details about sent or received Viber messages on an iOS device.

iOS.name: WeChat Friends
iOS.description: WeChat Friends contains stored contact information for the WeChat application on iOS.

iOS.name: WeChat Messages
iOS.description: WeChat Messages contains stored messages for the WeChat application on iOS.

iOS.name: WhatsApp Accounts Information - iOS
iOS.description: WhatsApp Accounts Information - iOS contains account information about the local WhatsApp user.

iOS.name: WhatsApp Calls
iOS.description: WhatsApp Calls contains information about voice and video calls made in WhatsApp.

iOS.name: WhatsApp Chats - iOS
iOS.description: WhatsApp Chats - iOS contains information about chat sessions that occur between the local user and another user or group. This artifact indicates the IDs of each participant as well as information about unread messages and the time when the last message was sent.

iOS.name: WhatsApp Contacts - iOS
iOS.description: WhatsApp Contacts - iOS contains contacts added to WhatsApp by the local user.

iOS.name: WhatsApp Groups - iOS

iOS.name: .DS_Store Records
iOS.description: .DS_Store Records contains all of the records that were extracted from .DS_Store files found on the computer. Each record represents a property of a file or a folder. This artifact is an indicator of high likelihood that the user of the computer was aware of these files and folders with a possibility of attributing a date to that awareness.

iOS.name: AirDrop Available Recipients
iOS.description: AirDrop Available Recipients lists all available recipients for an AirDrop transfer that was outgoing from the local device. The devices need to be in Bluetooth and WiFi range to connect to each other. You can recover up to one week of AirDrop activity history as it is stored in the Apple Unified Logs.

iOS.name: AirDrop Background Activity
iOS.description: AirDrop Background Activity is a collection of logs that capture background events triggered by the AirDrop service.

iOS.name: AirDrop Discoverability
iOS.description: AirDrop Discoverability lists changes to the discoverability status of device.

iOS.name: AirDrop Incoming Transfers
iOS.description: AirDrop Incoming Transfers lists information about AirDrop transfers incoming to the local device. The devices need to be in Bluetooth and WiFi range to connect to each other. You can recover up to one week of AirDrop activity history as it is stored in the Apple Unified Logs.

iOS.name: AirDrop Outgoing Transfers
iOS.description: AirDrop Outgoing Transfers lists information about AirDrop transfers outgoing from the local device. The devices need to be in Bluetooth and WiFi range to connect to each other. You can recover up to one week of AirDrop activity history as it is stored in the Apple Unified Logs.

iOS.name: Apple Accounts
iOS.description: Apple Accounts contains information about the Apple ID accounts used on the macOS computer. The account details contained can help investigators recover and correlate account information across applications, and provide information on what accounts to review and get more information from.

iOS.name: Apple Intelligence Genmoji
iOS.description: Apple Intelligence Genmoji contains information related to local user interaction with Apple Intelligence Genmoji features, which generates emoji stickers from user text or emoji inputs.

iOS.name: Apple Intelligence Image Playground
iOS.description: Apple Intelligence Image Playground contains AI-generated images created using Apple's Image Playground feature. Each image includes metadata about the generation prompts, styles, and reference images used.

iOS.name: Apple Intelligence Intelligent Siri
iOS.description: Apple Intelligence Intelligent Siri contains information related to local user interaction with Apple Intelligence Intelligent Siri.

iOS.name: Apple Intelligence Photos Search
iOS.description: Apple Intelligence Photos Search contains information related to natural language searches handled by Apple Intelligence in the Photos App.

iOS.name: Apple Intelligence Privacy Reports
iOS.description: Apple Intelligence Privacy Reports contains information related to local user interaction with Apple Intelligence features. The report is manually generated by the device user and may include information for up to 7 days from the time of generation. The report primarily focuses on requests that have been handled securely through Apple's specialized cloud infrastructure.

iOS.name: Apple Intelligence Visual Intelligence
iOS.description: Apple Intelligence Visual Intelligence contains information related to local user interaction with the Apple Intelligence Visual Intelligence through the mobile device's camera.

iOS.name: Cell Tower Locations
iOS.description: Cell Tower Locations contains records of which cell towers a device connects to at a given time.

iOS.name: File System Events
iOS.description: File System Events contains information about the changes to file system objects on an iOS device. This artifact contains all system event files recovered from the .fseventsd folder.

iOS.name: File System Information
iOS.description: File System Information contains all of the relevant information about the hard drives in use by the operating system.

iOS.name: Google Accounts
iOS.description: Google Accounts contains the Google accounts that are currently signed in on any Google application on the device.

iOS.name: IME Suggestions - Apple
iOS.description: IME Suggestions - Apple contains characters that have been suggested to the user as they use the Input Method Entry (IME) feature in iOS. This feature allows a user to provide a Unicode string and returns the equivalent characters as a suggestion.

iOS.name: iOS Home Screen Items
iOS.description: iOS Home Screen Items contains information about the applications and folders on the Home screen, including their specific locations. This artifact shows how the user has organized applications on their Home screen and can help identify applications of interest.

iOS.name: iOS Notifications Cache
iOS.description: iOS Notifications Cache contains the notifications that have been cached on the device.

iOS.name: iOS Notifications Cached Media
iOS.description: iOS Notifications Cached Media contains the media files that have been cached on the device through an application's notification.

iOS.name: Network Interfaces - iOS, macOS
iOS.description: Network Interfaces contains information about each of the networks the iOS device has been connected to.

iOS.name: Network Usage - Application Data
iOS.description: Network Usage Application Data contains information about how an application sends or receives data over the network.

iOS.name: Network Usage - Connections
iOS.description: Network Usage Connections contains information about the networks that a device connects to.

iOS.name: Owner Information
iOS.description: Owner Information contains information about the iOS device and the device owner. Information includes the device name, the phone number associated with the phone, and other details associated with iOS.

iOS.name: PowerLog App Usage
iOS.description: PowerLog App Usage contains information about the applications that were running on the device during a specified interval.

iOS.name: PowerLog Application State
iOS.description: PowerLog Application State contains information about application state transition.

iOS.name: PowerLog Battery Level
iOS.description: PowerLog Battery Level contains information about the phone's battery.

iOS.name: PowerLog Battery Shutdown
iOS.description: PowerLog Battery Shutdown contains information about when the phone's battery completely runs out and shuts down.

iOS.name: PowerLog Camera State
iOS.description: PowerLog Camera State contains information about changes to the camera state which indicate when a device's camera is in use.

iOS.name: PowerLog Device Lock State
iOS.description: PowerLog Device Lock State contains information about when the phone was locked or unlocked.

iOS.name: PowerLog In Call Service
iOS.description: PowerLog In Call Service contains information about when an application on the device was used to perform a call service.

iOS.name: PowerLog Lightning Cable Status
iOS.description: PowerLog Lightning Cable Status contains information about when the phone had a lightning cable connected or disconnected.

iOS.name: PowerLog Process Data Usage
iOS.description: PowerLog Process Data Usage contains information about the processes that were running on the device, and the amount of data that was sent and received during the specified interval.

iOS.name: PowerLog Screen Autolock
iOS.description: PowerLog Screen Autolock contains information about when the phone autolocked.

iOS.name: PowerLog Timezone Information
iOS.description: PowerLog Timezone Information contains information about the timezones that were registered on the device.

iOS.name: Private MAC Addresses - iOS
iOS.description: Private MAC Addresses saves details of the different MAC addresses used by the iOS device, which are added each time the user accesses a new network with the Private Wi-Fi Address setting enabled.

iOS.name: Siri Message Search Suggestions
iOS.description: Siri Message Search Suggestions contains the sent or received messages that Siri provides to the user as search results for a query. Queries can be typed in the search bar or spoken using Siri voice commands.

iOS.name: Unified Logs
iOS.description: Unified Logs contains parsed records of Apple Unified Logs from the default directory, including activity information for many different applications on an Apple device. It can be useful for determining a user's system interaction.

iOS.name: User Notification Events
iOS.description: User Notification Events contains data of notifications that have occurred on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Beam Transactions
iOS.description: Beam Transactions provides information about any logged transactions that have been sent by the user on the app.

iOS.name: BRD Transactions
iOS.description: BRD Transactions provides information about any logged transactions that have been sent by the user on the app.

iOS.name: Coinbase Purchases
iOS.description: Coinbase Purchases provides information about any cached cryptocurrency purchases that have happened on the app. Cached purchase information may not exist in all cases.

iOS.name: Coinbase Transactions
iOS.description: Coinbase Transactions provides information about any cached cryptocurrency transactions that have been sent by the user on the app. Cached transaction information may not exist in all cases.

iOS.name: Coinbase Users
iOS.description: Coinbase Users provides information about the cached local user.

iOS.name: Coinomi Transactions
iOS.description: Coinomi Transactions provides information about any logged transactions that have been sent/received by the user of the application. These records are carved and should be verified as they may include compressed or truncated data.

iOS.name: Exodus Transactions
iOS.description: Exodus Transactions provides information about any cached cryptocurrency transactions that have been sent or received by the user on the app. Cached transaction information may not exist in all cases.

iOS.name: Torrent Active Transfers
iOS.description: Torrent Active Transfers contains information about the torrents that are active on the user's system.

iOS.name: Torrent Feeds
iOS.description: Torrent Feeds contains information about RSS feeds that a user subscribes to that contains torrents available for download.

iOS.name: Torrent File Fragments
iOS.description: Torrent File Fragments contains data that is carved or parsed from .torrent files that are used to download torrents from various networks on the Internet.

iOS.name: Facebook Comments
iOS.description: Facebook Comments contains information about comments that have been cached on the device. A cached comment does not necessarily imply that the local account interacted with the comment, just that it was cached on the device. Further investigation should be performed to confirm the user's activity.

iOS.name: Facebook Posts
iOS.description: Facebook Posts contains information about posts that have been cached on the device. A cached post does not necessarily imply that the local account interacted with the post, just that it was cached on the device. Further investigation should be performed to confirm the user's activity.

iOS.name: Foursquare Check-ins
iOS.description: Foursquare Check-ins contains check-ins made by the iOS Foursquare application.

iOS.name: Foursquare Locations
iOS.description: Foursquare Locations contains locations cached by the iOS Foursquare application.

iOS.name: Grindr Group Members
iOS.description: Grindr Group Members contains the groups and their members within the current user's extracted iOS data.

iOS.name: Grindr Messages
iOS.description: Grindr Messages contains the messages and their details within the current user's extracted iOS data.

iOS.name: Grindr Users
iOS.description: Grindr Users contains the users and their details within the current user's extracted iOS data.

iOS.name: GROWLr Chat Messages
iOS.description: GROWLr Chat Messages contains messages stored by the iOS GROWLr application.

iOS.name: GROWLr Notes
iOS.description: GROWLr Notes contains notes stored by the iOS GROWLr application.

iOS.name: Instagram Direct Messages
iOS.description: Instagram Direct Messages contains Instagram direct messages that are sent or received by the local user.

iOS.name: Instagram Group Members
iOS.description: Instagram Group Members contains information about the Instagram groups that the local user is a member of.

iOS.name: Instagram Media
iOS.description: Instagram Media contains the media files that have been found inside the Instagram application.

iOS.name: Instagram Profiles
iOS.description: Instagram Profiles contains all the profile information that the local user has had communications with, or have been referred to through direct messages communication.

iOS.name: iOS Facebook Friends
iOS.description: iOS Facebook Friends contains the contact information of a user's friends stored by the Facebook application.

iOS.name: iOS Facebook Messages
iOS.description: iOS Facebook Messages contains Facebook messages recovered from the device.

iOS.name: iOS Instagram Posts
iOS.description: iOS Instagram Posts contains information about posts that a user has recently viewed on Instagram for iOS, as well as comments that are present on those posts.

iOS.name: iOS Tinder Accounts
iOS.description: iOS Tinder Accounts contains all of the recovered iOS Tinder accounts.

iOS.name: iOS Tinder Matches
iOS.description: iOS Tinder Matches contains all of a user's recovered iOS Tinder matches.

iOS.name: iOS Tinder Messages
iOS.description: iOS Tinder Messages contains all of a user's recovered iOS Tinder messages.

iOS.name: iOS Tinder Photos
iOS.description: iOS Tinder Photos contains all of the recovered iOS Tinder photos.

iOS.name: iOS Whisper Posts
iOS.description: iOS Whisper Posts contains the posts stored by the Whisper application.

iOS.name: Life360 Circle Members
iOS.description: Life30 Circle Members contains information about the members of a circle. A circle is comprised of a group of individuals, such as a family, that the local user has created or has been added to by another circle member.

iOS.name: Life360 Local User Account
iOS.description: Life360 Local User Account contains information about the local user account.

iOS.name: Life360 Messages
iOS.description: Life360 Messages contains messages sent and received by the local user within a circle that they're a member of.

iOS.name: Life360 Places
iOS.description: Life360 Places indicates favorite locations that are saved by the user or the application.

iOS.name: Life360 Trip Locations
iOS.description: Life360 Trip Locations indicates the locations that the user visits (or passes by on the way to a destination). During a trip, the application will log locations at regular intervals along the way.

iOS.name: LinkedIn Messages
iOS.description: LinkedIn Messages contains messages sent and received by the local user.

iOS.name: LinkedIn Profile
iOS.description: LinkedIn Profile contains information about the user accounts that the local user has used to log in on the device.

iOS.name: Musical.ly Local Users
iOS.description: Musical.ly Local Users contains all of the users that have logged in to Musical.ly on the local device.

iOS.name: Musical.ly Messages
iOS.description: Musical.ly Messages contains the messages sent or received via the in-app message system of Musical.ly.

iOS.name: Musical.ly Posts
iOS.description: Musical.ly Posts contains posts that Musical.ly retrieved from the web.

iOS.name: Musical.ly Users
iOS.description: Musical.ly Users contains all of the users that the local user has viewed in Musical.ly.

iOS.name: Parler Activity - iOS
iOS.description: Parler Activity contains information about the posts and comments that the local user has accessed or made.

iOS.name: Parler Users - iOS
iOS.description: Parler Users contains information about the local user account and any other users they've interacted with.

iOS.name: Pinterest Accounts
iOS.description: Pinterest Accounts contains information about the Pinterest accounts that the local user has logged in with on the device.

iOS.name: Pinterest Boards
iOS.description: Pinterest Boards contains information about the Pinterest boards created by local user.

iOS.name: Pinterest Messages
iOS.description: Pinterest Messages contains messages or pins sent and received by the local user.

iOS.name: Pinterest Pins
iOS.description: Pinterest Pins contains information about the items that the local user has pinned to their own board.

iOS.name: Reddit Accounts
iOS.description: Reddit Accounts contains information about the user accounts that are used to log in to the Reddit application on the device.

iOS.name: Reddit Posts
iOS.description: Reddit Posts contains information about the posts recovered from the device. These posts might be ones that the user has read or created on their device.

iOS.name: Reddit Recently Visited Subreddits
iOS.description: Reddit Recently Visited Subreddits contains information about the subreddits that a user has recently visited while on their device.

iOS.name: Sina Weibo Posts
iOS.description: Sina Weibo Posts contains user posts (similar to Twitter's tweets) on the Sina Weibo for iOS application.

iOS.name: Sina Weibo Private Messages
iOS.description: Sina Weibo Private Messages contains stored data from private messages on the Sina Weibo for iOS application.

iOS.name: TikTok Contacts
iOS.description: TikTok Contacts contains information about a user's contacts in TikTok.

iOS.name: TikTok Media
iOS.description: TikTok Media contains media that were either viewed or created by the user.

iOS.name: TikTok Messages
iOS.description: TikTok Messages contains information about the messages a user sends or receives using TikTok.

iOS.name: Tumblr Activity
iOS.description: Tumblr Activity provides information of how the Tumblr application accessed API URLs and any media that may accompany these requests.

iOS.name: Tumblr Blocked Blogs
iOS.description: Tumblr Blocked Blogs contains information about the blogs blocked by the local user.

iOS.name: Tumblr Chat Messages
iOS.description: Tumblr Chat Messages contains messages sent and received using Tumblr.

iOS.name: Tumblr Created Posts
iOS.description: Tumblr Created Posts contains information about the blog posts created by the local user.

iOS.name: Tumblr Followed Blogs
iOS.description: Tumblr Followed Blogs contains information about the blogs followed by the local user.

iOS.name: Tumblr Profiles
iOS.description: Tumblr Profiles contains information about the profiles encountered when using the Tumblr application.

iOS.name: Tumblr Tags
iOS.description: Tumblr Tags contains information about the subject tags the local user has selected. Selecting a tags expresses the user's interest in a subject so they can see more content of that type.

iOS.name: Twitter Calls
iOS.description: Twitter Calls contains parsed calls from the Twitter application.

iOS.name: Twitter Direct Messages
iOS.description: Twitter Direct Messages contains carved and noncarved direct messages from the Twitter application. Note that carving may not retrieve the name and screen name of sender and receiver.

iOS.name: Twitter Tweets
iOS.description: Twitter Tweets contains carved and noncarved tweets from the Twitter application. Note that carving older versions of the application will only recover the Tweet column.

iOS.name: Twitter Users
iOS.description: Twitter Users contains information about users that were cached on the local user's device.

iOS.name: VK Messages
iOS.description: This artifact contains VK messages (either private or group messages) as well as the details about pictures, video, and audio that may have been sent.

iOS.name: VK Users
iOS.description: This artifact contains the various VK users that the data owner has been in communication with, as well as the users own profile.

iOS.name: Whisper Messages
iOS.description: Whisper Messages contains the messages that were sent and received between the local user and others.

iOS.name: X (Twitter) Grok Cached Files
iOS.description: X (Twitter) Grok Cached Files contains cached files (such as photos, videos, and documents) from Grok AI conversations within the X (Twitter) application. Only files that were cached to disk are recoverable.

iOS.name: X (Twitter) Grok User Accounts
iOS.description: X (Twitter) Grok User Accounts contains the local user account(s) that interacted with Grok, recovered from the X (Twitter) application on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Yik Yak Notifications
iOS.description: Yik Yak Notifications contains the notifications that have been generated for the user.

iOS.name: Yik Yak Yaks
iOS.description: Yik Yak Yaks contains the Yaks the user has viewed on their homepage.

iOS.name: Aloha Browser Bookmarks
iOS.description: Aloha Bookmarks contains the webpages that a user has bookmarked.

iOS.name: Aloha Browser Downloads
iOS.description: Aloha Browser Downloads contains information about the files that a user downloads from the Internet.

iOS.name: Aloha Browser History
iOS.description: Aloha Browser History contains information about the websites that the user visits.

iOS.name: Bolt Browser Bookmarks
iOS.description: Bolt Browser Bookmarks contains stored bookmark entries for the Bolt browser on iOS.

iOS.name: Bolt Browser History
iOS.description: Bolt Browser History contains stored history entries for the Bolt browser on iOS.

iOS.name: Brave Bookmarks
iOS.description: Brave Bookmarks contain bookmarks that reference saved webpages.

iOS.name: Brave FavIcons
iOS.description: Brave Favicons contains the favicons that Brave displays in the address bar when visiting a website. These icons are sometimes downloaded when you favorite/bookmark a website.

iOS.name: Brave Tab History
iOS.description: Brave Tab History contains the websites that the user visits in a particular tab, sorted by order in which they were visited.

iOS.name: Brave Web History - iOS
iOS.description: Brave Web History contains a history of all the websites that the user visits (includes unique visits only).

iOS.name: ChatGPT Attachments
iOS.description: ChatGPT Attachments contains cached media attachments from ChatGPT Conversations stored in the Kingfisher image cache and fsCachedData (NSURLCache) directories. These attachments include user-uploaded images, DALL-E generated images, GPT icons, and cached video content. Non-media files (such as JSON API responses) in the cache are automatically filtered out.

iOS.name: ChatGPT Conversations
iOS.description: ChatGPT Conversations contains conversation metadata created by the local user with ChatGPT models. Conversations can be temporary or saved, and they include information such as the title, message count, and timestamps.

iOS.name: ChatGPT Group Conversation Members
iOS.description: ChatGPT Group Conversation Members contains individual user profiles extracted from ChatGPT group conversations on iOS. Each entry represents a user's membership in a specific group conversation — one hit is produced per (user, group) pair.

iOS.name: ChatGPT Group Conversations
iOS.description: ChatGPT Group Conversations contains group conversation metadata from the ChatGPT iOS application. Group conversations include information such as the name, member IDs, member names, and timestamps.

iOS.name: ChatGPT Local User Details
iOS.description: ChatGPT Local User Details contains metadata for the local user using ChatGPT on the device. The ChatGPT identifiers available here can be associated and linked to the evidence data.

iOS.name: ChatGPT Messages
iOS.description: ChatGPT Messages contains conversations that the local user has with ChatGPT models. The messages can be text, images, or other media types. The table also includes metadata about the messages such as the sender, recipient, and timestamps.

iOS.name: ChatGPT Projects
iOS.description: ChatGPT Projects contains metadata for the projects created by the local user in ChatGPT.

iOS.name: Chrome Affiliations
iOS.description: Chrome Affiliations contains information about visited pages and the domains their affiliated domains. Typical examples are; login page, advertiser, or CDN affiliated with a larger domain.

iOS.name: Chrome Application Cache Records
iOS.description: Chrome Application Cache Records contains content that Chrome downloads and caches to speed up rendering times. Cached content can include pictures, text, HTML, JavaScript, and more.

iOS.name: Chrome Archived Keyword Search Terms
iOS.description: Chrome Archived Keyword Search Terms contains keyword search terms that were archived by the browser.

iOS.name: Chrome Archived Web History
iOS.description: Chrome Archived Web History contains an archived history of old webpage visits.

iOS.name: Chrome Autofill
iOS.description: Chrome Autofill contains records of the autofill values that Chrome saves for different types of text fields.

iOS.name: Chrome Autofill Profiles
iOS.description: Chrome Autofill Profiles contains profiles and addresses that Chrome may use to autofill forms with saved values.

iOS.name: Chrome Bookmarks
iOS.description: Chrome Bookmarks contains browser bookmarks that reference saved webpages.

iOS.name: Chrome Cache Records
iOS.description: Chrome Cache Records contains content that Chrome downloads and caches to speed up rendering times. Cached content can include pictures, text, HTML, JavaScript, and more.

iOS.name: Chrome Cookies
iOS.description: Chrome Cookies contains cookies that Chrome downloads from the Internet that contain information about the websites that a user visits.

iOS.name: Chrome Current Session
iOS.description: Chrome Current Session contains information about the browser session that's currently underway.

iOS.name: Chrome Current Tabs
iOS.description: Chrome Current Tabs contains information about the tabs that are open in the current browser session.

iOS.name: Chrome Downloads
iOS.description: Chrome Downloads contains information about the files that a user downloads from the Internet.

iOS.name: Chrome FavIcons
iOS.description: Chrome FavIcons contains the favicons that Chrome displays in the address bar for the website that's currently displayed. These icons are sometimes downloaded when you favorite/bookmark a website.

iOS.name: Chrome GPU Cache Records
iOS.description: Chrome GPU Cache Records contains content that Chrome downloads and caches to speed up rendering times. Cached content can include textures, shader code, and other graphics related content.

iOS.name: Chrome History Index
iOS.description: Chrome History Index contains an index of the webpages that the user has visited in the past.

iOS.name: Chrome Keyword Search Terms
iOS.description: Chrome Keyword Search Terms contains information about the keyword search terms that a user enters.

iOS.name: Chrome Last Session
iOS.description: Chrome Last Session contains information about the previous browser session.

iOS.name: Chrome Last Tabs
iOS.description: Chrome Last Tabs contains information about the tabs that were open during the previous session.

iOS.name: Chrome Logins
iOS.description: Android Chrome Logins contains login information that a user provides in Chrome. Passwords are often encrypted, so you might not be able to recover them unless you're examining a live system.

iOS.name: Chrome Media Cache Records
iOS.description: Chrome Media Cache Records contains content that Chrome downloads and caches to speed up rendering times. Cached content can include video and audio related content.

iOS.name: Chrome Saved Credit Cards
iOS.description: Chrome Saved Credit Cards contains the credit card information saved by the user.

iOS.name: Chrome Shortcuts
iOS.description: Chrome Shortcuts contains all of the shortcuts used by Google Chrome for user entered URLs.

iOS.name: Chrome Sync Accounts
iOS.description: Chrome Sync Accounts contains information about the Chrome accounts that a user has logged in with. Chrome syncs data to the cloud so that a user can log in on multiple devices.

iOS.name: Chrome Tab History
iOS.description: Chrome Tab History contains a history of websites that the user has opened on each tab within the application. Each tab contains its own timeline of activity generated by the user.

iOS.name: Chrome Top Sites
iOS.description: A list of the websites that are the most popular to the user. Top sites are displayed on the browser home page which allows the user to quickly click on a frequently visited site.

iOS.name: Chrome Web History
iOS.description: Chrome Web History contains a history of the websites that the user visits (includes unique visits only).

iOS.name: Chrome Web Visits
iOS.description: Chrome Web Visits contains a history of the websites that the user visits (includes all visits).

iOS.name: Dolphin Browser Bookmarks
iOS.description: Dolphin Browser Bookmarks contains bookmarks from the Dolphin web browser on an iOS device.

iOS.name: Dolphin Browser History
iOS.description: Dolphin Browser History contains the webpage history from the Dolphin web browser on an iOS device.

iOS.name: DuckDuckGo Bookmarks
iOS.description: DuckDuckGo Bookmarks contains information about the webpages that a user has bookmarked.

iOS.name: DuckDuckGo Current Tabs
iOS.description: DuckDuckGo Current Tabs contains information about the tabs that are open in the current DuckDuckGo browser session.

iOS.name: DuckDuckGo Whitelisted Websites
iOS.description: DuckDuckGo Whitelisted Websites contains information on domains that have been added by the user to the whitelist or fireproof list of domains.

iOS.name: Ecosia Bookmarks
iOS.description: Ecosia Bookmarks contains the webpages that a user has bookmarked in the browser.

iOS.name: Ecosia Current Tabs
iOS.description: Ecosia Current Tabs contains information about the tabs that the user currently has open in the browser.

iOS.name: Ecosia Web History
iOS.description: Ecosia Web History contains information about the webpages that a user has visited (includes unique visits only).

iOS.name: Edge Bookmarks
iOS.description: Edge Bookmarks contains browser bookmarks that reference saved webpages.

iOS.name: Edge Current Session
iOS.description: Edge Current Session contains information about the browser session that's currently underway.

iOS.name: Edge Current Tabs
iOS.description: Edge Current Tabs contains information about the tabs that are open in the current browser session.

iOS.name: Edge FavIcons
iOS.description: Edge FavIcons contains the favicons that Edge displays in the address bar for the website that's currently displayed. These icons are sometimes downloaded when you favorite or bookmark a website.

iOS.name: Edge Last Session
iOS.description: Edge Last Session contains information about the previous browser session.

iOS.name: Edge Last Tabs
iOS.description: Edge Last Tabs contains information about the tabs that were open during the previous session.

iOS.name: Edge Logins
iOS.description: Edge Logins contains login information that a user provides in Edge. Passwords are often encrypted, so you might not be able to recover those unless you're examining a live system.

iOS.name: Edge Web History
iOS.description: Edge Web History contains a history of the websites that a user has visited. Each artifact hit represents a unique webpage visit, whereas subsequent visits to the same page are tracked by the page's visit count.

iOS.name: Google Analytics First Visit Cookies
iOS.description: Google Analytics First Visit Cookies contains information about Google Analytics first-visit cookies that are discovered in other artifacts.

iOS.name: Google Analytics First Visit Cookies Carved
iOS.description: Google Analytics First Visit Cookies Carved contains information about Google Analytics first-visit cookies that are recovered using carving.

iOS.name: Google Analytics Referral Cookies
iOS.description: Google Analytics Referral Cookies contains information about Google Analytics referral cookies that are discovered in other artifacts.

iOS.name: Google Analytics Referral Cookies Carved
iOS.description: Google Analytics Referral Cookies Carved contains information about Google Analytics referral cookies that are recovered using carving.

iOS.name: Google Analytics Session Cookies
iOS.description: Google Analytics Session Cookies contains information about Google Analytics session cookies that are discovered in other artifacts.

iOS.name: Google Analytics Session Cookies Carved
iOS.description: Google Analytics Session Cookies Carved contains information about Google Analytics session cookies that are recovered using carving.

iOS.name: Google Analytics URLs
iOS.description: Google Analytics URLs contains URLs that are discovered in other artifacts that are related to Google Analytics.

iOS.name: Google Analytics URLs Carved
iOS.description: Google Analytics URLs Carved contains information about Google Analytics URLs that are recovered using carving.

iOS.name: Google Gemini Active Account
iOS.description: Google Gemini Active Account identifies the currently active Google account within the Gemini app. The active account ID is extracted from the ActiveAccountIDsFile binary plist and cross-referenced with the shared Google sign-in retention data to resolve the associated email address and display name.

iOS.name: Google Gemini Media Files
iOS.description: Google Gemini Media Files contains cached and user-uploaded media from Google Gemini conversations. Cached media is recovered from the GIPPersistentCache ImageCache directory along with metadata such as access times. User-uploaded media is recovered from the application's tmp directory.

iOS.name: Grok Cached Files
iOS.description: Grok Cached Files contains cached media files (for example, photos, videos, documents).

iOS.name: Grok Local User
iOS.description: Grok Local User contains information about the Grok user on the device.

iOS.name: iOS Safari Cache Records
iOS.description: iOS Safari Cache contains Locally cached content from the Safari browser on iOS.

iOS.name: iOS Safari Recent Search Terms
iOS.description: iOS Safari Recent Search Terms contains the search terms that a user runs in the Safari browser.

iOS.name: Malware/Phishing URLs
iOS.description: Malware/Phishing URLs contains records that are believed to be either malware or phishing related URLs.

iOS.name: Pornography URLs
iOS.description: Pornography URLs contains records that are believed to be pornography related URLs.

iOS.name: Potential Browser Activity
iOS.description: The Potential Browser Activity artifact will recover browser-related URLs. This includes Chrome Incognito and Firefox Private Browsing URLs, HTTP request artifacts from multiple browsers, and regular web browsing artifacts. This does not include metadata such as the Windows username, dates and times, and so on. Note that some recovered URLs can be from background browser processes related to certificate authorities.

iOS.name: Puffin Browser Bookmarks
iOS.description: Puffin Browser Bookmarks contains bookmarks from the Puffin Browser for iOS.

iOS.name: Puffin Browser History
iOS.description: Puffin Browser History contains the web history for the Puffin Browser for iOS.

iOS.name: Rebuilt Webpages
iOS.description: Rebuilt Webpages contains the data that allows for the reconstruction of webpages.

iOS.name: Safari Bookmarks
iOS.description: Safari Bookmarks contains stored bookmarks for the Safari browser on iOS.

iOS.name: Safari Downloads
iOS.description: Safari is a web browser developed by Apple. Safari is installed by default on all Mac computers and is available for Windows. This table captures information related to files that have been downloaded from Safari.

iOS.name: Safari Favicons
iOS.description: Safari Favicons contain website icons cached by the Safari browser on iOS. Each record links a webpage URL to its associated favicon image file.

iOS.name: Safari History
iOS.description: Safari History contains stored history entries for the Safari browser on iOS.

iOS.name: Safari iCloud Devices
iOS.description: Safari iCloud Devices contains information about the devices that are synced to an iCloud account. Each device can access any browser tabs that are synced to the account.

iOS.name: Safari iCloud Tabs
iOS.description: Safari iCloud Tabs contains information about tabs that have been opened in the browser and synced to an iCloud account. Synchronized tabs are available to any device that logs in to the iCloud account.

iOS.name: Safari Last Session
iOS.description: Safari Last Session captures information related to the last time the user browsed the internet using Safari.

iOS.name: Safari Suspended State Tabs
iOS.description: Safari Suspended State Tabs contains the current state of each browser tab in Safari that is currently open on the local device. The date and time are only updated when the user interacts with that tab on the local device. Since these are local tab states, results from this artifact may contain an earlier date and time compared to the results in the Safari History Artifact if iCloud Safari synchronization is enabled across multiple devices on one iCloud account.

iOS.name: WebKit Browser Session/Tabs (Carved)
iOS.description: WebKit Browser Sessions/Tabs contains information about the browser sessions and tabs that the user has open, while using a browser built with WebKit. Some examples of browsers that use WebKit are Chrome, Opera, and 360 Safe Browser. This artifact consolidates the existing Chrome, Safe Browser, and Opera equivalents in a single artifact. Usage of other browsers, such as Firefox and Safari, aren't likely to appear under this artifact.

iOS.name: WebKit Browser Web History (Carved)
iOS.description: WebKit Browser Web History contains information about the websites that a user visits while using a browser built with WebKit. Some examples of browsers that use WebKit are Chrome, Opera, and 360 Safe Browser. This artifact consolidates the existing Chrome, Safe Browser, and Opera equivalents in a single artifact. Usage of other browsers aren't likely to appear under this artifact, however, some URLs found by other browsers may also be found by this artifact.

iOS.name: Whale Autofill
iOS.description: Whale Autofill contains records of the autofill values that Whale saves for different types of text fields.

iOS.name: Whale Bookmarks
iOS.description: Whale Browser Bookmarks contains browser bookmarks that reference saved webpages.

iOS.name: Whale Cookies
iOS.description: Whale Cookies contains cookies that Whale downloads from the Internet that contain information about the websites that a user visits.

iOS.name: Whale Downloads
iOS.description: Whale Downloads contains information about the files that a user downloads from the Internet.

iOS.name: Whale FavIcons
iOS.description: Whale Favicons contains the favicons that Whale displays in the address bar for the website that's currently displayed. These icons are sometimes downloaded when you favorite or bookmark a website.

iOS.name: Whale Keyword Search Terms
iOS.description: Whale Keyword Search Terms contains information about the keyword search terms that a user enters.

iOS.name: Whale Logins
iOS.description: Whale Logins contains login information that a user provides in Whale. Passwords are often encrypted, so you might not be able to recover those unless you're examining a live system.

iOS.name: Whale Top Sites
iOS.description: Whale Top Sites contains a list of the websites that are the most popular to the user. Top sites are displayed on the browser homepage which allows the user to quickly click on a frequently visited site.

iOS.name: Whale Web History
iOS.description: Whale Web History contains a history of the websites that the user visits (includes unique visits only).

iOS.name: Whale Web Visits
iOS.description: Whale Web Visits contains a history of the websites that the user visits (includes all visits).

iOS.name: Yahoo! Japan Auctions Browsing History

iOS.name: Yahoo! Japan Auctions Search History

iOS.name: Yandex Downloads

iOS.name: Yandex FavIcons
