iOS.name: Yandex Keyword Search Terms
iOS.description: Yandex Keyword Search Terms contains information about the keyword search terms that a user enters.

iOS.name: Yandex Logins
iOS.description: Login information that a user provides in Yandex. Passwords are often encrypted, so you might not be able to recover those unless you're examining a live system.

iOS.name: Yandex Shortcuts
iOS.description: Contains all of the shortcuts used by Yandex for user entered URLs.

iOS.name: Yandex Sync Data
iOS.description: Yandex Sync Data contains information about the data that Yandex has synced to a user's account in the cloud.

iOS.name: Yandex Top Sites
iOS.description: A list of the websites that are the most popular to the user. Top sites are displayed on the browser home page which allows the user to quickly click on a frequently visited site.

iOS.name: Yandex Web History
iOS.description: A history of the websites that the user visits (includes unique visits only).

iOS.name: Yandex Web Visits
iOS.description: A history of the websites that the user visits (includes all visits).

iOS.name: YARA Rule Matches
iOS.description: The YARA artifact contains information about files and processes that matched with conditions specified in a YARA rule.

macOS.name: Android Backups
macOS.description: Android Backups contains information about any backups of Android devices that are recovered from the computer. If an Android backup is recovered during a search, you can search the contents of the backup for additional artifacts.

macOS.name: Apple Disk Images
macOS.description: Apple disk images are commonly stored as DMG or IMG files. These files are containers that may contain additional items of interest. This artifact identifies any Apple disk image found on the system.

macOS.name: iOS Backups
macOS.description: iOS Backups contains information about any backups of iOS devices that are recovered from the computer. If an iOS backup is recovered during a search, you can search the contents of the backup for additional artifacts.

macOS.name: Apple Maps - Biome App Intents
macOS.description: Apple Maps - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the Apple Maps app related to locations and navigation.

macOS.name: Application Install States
macOS.description: Application Install States contains a list of state changes that occur while an application installs or is uninstalled on an iOS device.

macOS.name: Application Permissions - MacOS, iOS
macOS.description: Application Permissions contains information about the app permissions that a user is prompted to accept or decline while using macOS applications.

macOS.name: Biome Application Focus
macOS.description: Biome Application Focus provides information about the applications that were in focus on the device screen, within a recorded interval.

macOS.name: Biome Application Install States
macOS.description: Biome Application Install States provides information about when applications were installed on the device.

macOS.name: Biome Application Intents
macOS.description: Biome Application Intents provides additional context and details about user interactions with the device. Application Intents are recorded by the system and are not always initiated by user interaction. For example, an intent is recorded when the user initiates a call and also when a call is received but isn't answered.

macOS.name: Biome Application Launch
macOS.description: Biome Application Launch provides information about when applications were launched on the device.

macOS.name: Biome CarPlay Connections
macOS.description: Biome CarPlay provides information about when the device was connected with a vehicle using CarPlay.

macOS.name: Biome Device Orientation States
macOS.description: Biome Device Orientation States provides information about the orientation of the device within recorded intervals.

macOS.name: Biome Device Plugged-in States
macOS.description: Biome Device Plugged-in States provides information about when the device was plugged in.

macOS.name: Biome Device Screen Backlight States
macOS.description: Biome Screen Backlight States provides information about the device backlight within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time. This information can help identify whether a device was in active use within a specific interval.

macOS.name: Biome Do Not Disturb Status
macOS.description: Biome Do Not Disturb Status provides information about when the device was put into the Do Not Disturb state.

macOS.name: Biome Keybag Lock States
macOS.description: Biome Keybag Lock States provides information about when the device was locked and unlocked. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time.

macOS.name: Biome Safari History
macOS.description: Biome Safari History provides information about webpages that were accessed using the Safari browser, as recovered from iOS Biome

macOS.name: Biome Safari Page View

macOS.name: Biome Siri Execution

macOS.name: Biome Siri UI Usage

macOS.name: Biome User Activity
macOS.description: Biome User Activity provides information about various actions user performed on a device.

macOS.name: Claude Command History
macOS.description: Claude Command History contains a chronological record of every user input entered across all Claude sessions and projects. This global command history is stored in ~/Library/Application Support/.claude/history.jsonl and provides a complete timeline of user interactions with Claude, independent of individual conversation sessions. Commands include text prompts, code requests, slash commands (for example, /usage, /status, /exit), and any other user input typed into the Claude interface.

macOS.name: Claude Conversations
macOS.description: Claude Conversations contains conversations that the local user has with Claude AI models through the Claude Desktop application. The messages include text exchanges, code generation, analysis requests, and other interactions. Conversations are stored in JSONL transcript files organized by working directory and session.

macOS.name: Cowork Audit Logs
macOS.description: Cowork Audit Logs contain audit trails of Claude Desktop Cowork mode sessions. Each line in the audit.jsonl file is a discrete event with a timestamp, type, and associated metadata. Events include user messages, AI responses, thinking blocks (Claude's internal reasoning process), tool execution (file operations, commands, searches), rate limit tracking, system state changes, and HMAC integrity verification. The logs are stored in ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/local-agent-mode-sessions/{vm-uuid}/{user-uuid}/local_{session-uuid}/audit.jsonl.

macOS.name: Facebook Messenger - Biome App Intents
macOS.description: Facebook Messenger - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the Facebook Messenger app related to sent and received messages and calls.

macOS.name: Instagram - Biome App Intents
macOS.description: Instagram - Biome App Intents contains information about application intents from the Instagram app related to sent and received messages.

macOS.name: KnowledgeC Device Lock States

macOS.name: KnowledgeC Device Orientation States

An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time. Knowing whenever a device is connected to charger or computer using USB can help identify how the device is used.

macOS.name: KnowledgeC Keybag Lock States
macOS.description: KnowledgeC Keybag Lock States provides information about whether the device's keybag is locked or unlocked within recorded intervals. An absence of a recorded interval might mean that device was turned off during that time.

macOS.name: KnowledgeC Media History

macOS.description: Videos contains videos that are recovered using parsing or carving. Supported formats for parsing include AVI, MP4, MOV, MPEG, DIVX, A3GP, ASF, WMV, DVR-MS, MKV, VOB, MOD, and WEBM. Supported carving formats include AVI, MP4, DIVX, A3GP, M4A, QT, and WEBM. macOS.name: Web Video Fragments
macOS.description: This search recovers two distinct types of web-based videos. Fragments of Flash video can be left behind by many video streaming sites, such as YouTube. RTMP Frame Fragments are frames left behind by streaming sites using the RTMP protocol (widely used by webcam chat sites, including Chatroulette and Camstumble). In the case, a thumbnail from a recovered video is displayed, as well as any relevant metadata. Videos can be exported to .FLV format to be played. Due to the nature of the data recovered, some video players will have issues playing the exported files. We recommend trying FFmpeg, VLC, and the GOM player.

macOS.name: AirDrop Background Activity

macOS.name: AirDrop Discoverability

macOS.name: AirDrop Incoming Transfers
macOS.description: AirDrop Incoming Transfers lists information about AirDrop transfers incoming to the local device. The devices need to be in Bluetooth and WiFi range to connect to each other. You can recover up to one week of AirDrop activity history as it is stored in the Apple Unified Logs.

macOS.name: AirDrop Outgoing Transfers
macOS.description: AirDrop Outgoing Transfers lists information about AirDrop transfers outgoing from the local device. The devices need to be in Bluetooth and WiFi range to connect to each other. You can recover up to one week of AirDrop activity history as it is stored in the Apple Unified Logs.

macOS.name: Anacron Jobs
macOS.description: Anacron jobs are used to execute tasks at a certain frequency on machines that may be powered off.

macOS.name: Apple Intelligence Privacy Reports
macOS.description: Apple Intelligence Privacy Reports contains information related to local user interaction with Apple Intelligence features. The report primarily focuses on requests that have been handled securely through Apple's specialized cloud infrastructure.

macOS.name: Bash / ZSH Sessions

macOS.name: CoreAnalytics
macOS.description: CoreAnalytics contains information about macOS system usage and application execution history. This artifact gives an overview of applications and processes used during historical and current activity periods.

macOS.name: Cron Jobs
macOS.description: Cron jobs are used to execute tasks at a certain frequency on continuously running machines.

macOS.name: Cron Schedule
macOS.description: Cron jobs are used to execute tasks at a certain frequency on continuously running machines.

macOS.name: CUPS Print Jobs

macOS.name: Daily Logs - Disk Status

macOS.name: Daily Logs - Local System Status

macOS.name: Daily Logs - Network Interfaces Status

macOS.name: Deleted Accounts
macOS.description: Deleted Accounts contains information about the accounts that have been deleted from the macOS computer.

macOS.name: Dock Items
macOS.description: Dock Items contains information about the applications that have appeared in the dock. Usually, these items are recently or often used applications.

macOS.name: File System Events
macOS.description: File System Events contains information about the changes to file system objects, occurring in volumes mounted on a macOS computer. This artifact contains all system event files recovered from the .fseventsd folder.

macOS.name: File System Information (APFS)
macOS.description: File System Information (APFS) contains information about the file system of the macOS computer.

macOS.name: Finder MRU
macOS.description: Finder MRU lists the recently accessed paths from the Finder application on macOS.

macOS.name: Finder Sidebar Items
macOS.description: Finder Sidebar Items contains information about each of the items featured in the Finder Sidebar on macOS. Items in the sidebar are often commonly-used items, and the user can customize the types of items they want to appear.

macOS.name: IME Suggestions - Apple
macOS.description: IME Suggestions - Apple contains characters that have been suggested to the user as they use the Input Method Entry (IME) feature in macOS. This feature allows a user to provide a Unicode string and returns the equivalent characters as a suggestion.

macOS.name: Latent Wireless Geolocated WiFi Hotspots
macOS.description: Latent Wireless Geolocated WiFi Hotspots contains information about WiFi hotspots that were discovered using a Latent Wireless device. Latent Wireless stores information about the hotspots in a database that Magnet AXIOM can parse for details about each hotspot.

macOS.name: Login History
macOS.description: Login History contains information about the date and time when a user logged in or out of the macOS system.

macOS.name: Menu Bar Apps
macOS.description: Menu Bar Items lists the applications that are listed in the menu bar on macOS. The menu bar appears at the top of the screen and allows the user to open and interact with the applications that are displayed. Some menu bar items are displayed by default, while others might be added by the user.

macOS.name: Network Interfaces - iOS, macOS
macOS.description: Network Interfaces contains information about each of the network the macOS computer has been connected to.

macOS.name: Network Profiles - macOS
macOS.description: Network Profiles contains information about networks that have been saved to the device. This artifact can reveal current networks that are frequently in use, as well as archived networks.

macOS.name: Network Usage - Application Data
macOS.description: Network Usage Application Data contains information about how an application sends or receives data over the network.

macOS.name: Network Usage - Connections
macOS.description: Network Usage Connections contains information about the networks that a device connects to.

macOS.name: Network Utilities
macOS.description: Network Utilities contains information about tools run in the Network Utilities application on macOS (Info, Ping, Netstat, Lookup, etc). Each instance of the artifact indicates the utility that's used and the query (or URL) passed in to the utility. The results of running the utility are not recoverable.

macOS.name: Operating System Information - macOS
macOS.description: Operating System Information contains details about the macOS instance that's running on the user's computer.

macOS.name: PowerLog App Usage
macOS.description: PowerLog App Usage contains information about the applications that were running on the device during a specified interval.

macOS.name: PowerLog Application State
macOS.description: PowerLog Application State contains information about application state transition.

macOS.name: PowerLog Battery Level
macOS.description: PowerLog Battery Level contains information about the phone's battery.

macOS.name: PowerLog Battery Shutdown
macOS.description: PowerLog Battery Shutdown contains information about when the phone's battery completely runs out and shuts down.

macOS.name: PowerLog Camera State
macOS.description: PowerLog Camera State contains information about changes to the camera state which indicate when a device's camera is in use.

macOS.name: PowerLog Device Lock State
macOS.description: PowerLog Device Lock State contains information about when the phone was locked or unlocked.

macOS.name: PowerLog In Call Service
macOS.description: PowerLog In Call Service contains information about when an application on the device was used to perform a call service.

macOS.name: PowerLog Lightning Cable Status
macOS.description: PowerLog Lightning Cable Status contains information about when the phone had a lightning cable connected or disconnected.

macOS.name: PowerLog Process Data Usage
macOS.description: PowerLog Process Data Usage contains information about the processes that were running on the device, and the amount of data that was sent and received during the specified interval.

macOS.name: PowerLog Screen Autolock
macOS.description: PowerLog Screen Autolock contains information about when the phone autolocked.

macOS.name: PowerLog Timezone Information
macOS.description: PowerLog Timezone Information contains information about the timezones that were registered on the device.

macOS.name: Quarantined Files
macOS.description: Quarantined Files contains information about the files that were flagged as quarantined in the macOS computer.

macOS.name: Rebuilt Desktops - macOS
macOS.description: Rebuilt Desktops is an artifact that allows users to view an approximation of what a given macOS user's desktop looks like, including wallpapers, monitor configurations, and desktop icons, without having to virtualize the image.

macOS.name: Recent Files
macOS.description: The Recent Files artifact contains information about the files that are accessed by a user.

macOS.name: Recently Used Items
macOS.description: Recently Used Items lists the most recently accessed items from a variety of sources. Each data source stores its recently used information in a separate file. For example, RecentDocuments aggregates information about all the documents that are opened, regardless of the application. RecentApplications contains information about each application that runs. And, app-specific sources can contain information specific to a particular application.

macOS.name: Recovery Account Information
macOS.description: Recovery Account Information lists the user accounts that have privileges to decrypt a FileVault encrypted volume in APFS.

macOS.name: Resumed Apps
macOS.description: Resumed Apps has information about the applications that are set to reopen after the macOS computer restarts or resumes after going to sleep.

macOS.name: Spotlight Shortcuts
macOS.description: Spotlight Shortcuts contains information about the searches that a user performs in the Spotlight application on macOS. The display name can indicate a local file or folder, application, or online search results.

macOS.name: SSH Authorized Keys
macOS.description: SSH Authorized keys are pre-configured keys used for logging into user accounts.

macOS.name: SSH Keys
macOS.description: SSH Keys are used to perform secure activities over the internet.

macOS.name: SSH Known Hosts
macOS.description: SSH Known Hosts are public keys used to verify the identity of remote hosts. These are often automatically populated when the user connects to a host for the first time, but they can also be added manually.

macOS.name: Startup Items - macOS
macOS.description: Startup Items contains information about the processes and applications that are set to run at startup on a macOS computer.

macOS.name: Trash Items
macOS.description: Trash Items contains information about the items that a user has sent to the trash. There is also a potential of recovering items that have been cleared from the trash. This artifact does not recover folder or directory objects unless they're listed in the .DS_Store file.

macOS.name: Trash Items - macOS
macOS.description: Trash Items contains information about the items that a user has sent to the trash. There is also a potential of recovering items that have been cleared from the trash. This artifact does not recover folder or directory objects unless they're listed in the .DS_Store file.

macOS.name: Unified Logs

macOS.name: User Accounts - macOS

macOS.name: Volume Information

macOS.name: Active Connections

macOS.name: Safari Favicons
macOS.description: Safari Favicons contain website icons cached by the Safari browser. Each record links a webpage URL to its associated favicon image file.

macOS.name: Safari History
macOS.description: Safari is a web browser developed by Apple. Safari is installed by default on all Mac computers and is available for windows. This table captures history entries which have been parsed from the filesystem.

macOS.name: Safari HSTS
macOS.description: Safari HSTS contains the list of hosts that sent an HTTP Strict Transport Security policy to Safari, recovered from the WebKit HSTS.plist. Because the browser retains this list to enforce HTTPS-only connections, it can indicate hosts that were contacted even after browsing history is cleared.

macOS.name: Safari iCloud Devices
macOS.description: Safari iCloud Devices contains information about the devices that are synced to an iCloud account. Each device can access any browser tabs that are synced to the account.

macOS.name: Safari iCloud Tabs
macOS.description: Safari iCloud Tabs contains information about tabs that have been opened in the browser and synced to an iCloud account. Synchronized tabs are available to any device that logs in to the iCloud account.

macOS.name: Safari ITP Cross-Site Relationships
macOS.description: Safari ITP Cross-Site Relationships contains the cross-site loading relationships Safari's Intelligent Tracking Prevention observed, recovered from the relationship tables of the WebKit observations.db. Each entry records that a third-party host was loaded (as a subresource, subframe, script, or redirect) while the user was on a top-level domain, reconstructing the cross-site tracking graph.

macOS.name: Safari ITP Domains
macOS.description: Safari ITP Domains contains the domains Safari's Intelligent Tracking Prevention (ITP) observed in a cross-site context, recovered from the ObservedDomains table of the WebKit observations.db. It records how ITP classified each domain and when it was last seen or interacted with. Because classifications can persist after stored data is removed, this can evidence tracker relationships that survived a history clear.

macOS.name: Safari ITP Operating Dates
macOS.description: Safari ITP Operating Dates contains the calendar days on which Safari's Intelligent Tracking Prevention processed tracking data, recovered from the OperatingDates table of the WebKit observations.db. Each entry corresponds to a day the browser was used enough for ITP to run, forming a browsing-activity timeline that can persist after browsing history is cleared.

macOS.name: Safari Last Session
macOS.description: Safari is a web browser developed by Apple. Safari is installed by default on all Mac computers and is available for windows. This table captures information related to the user's last session with Safari.

macOS.name: Safari Local Storage
macOS.description: Safari Local Storage contains the per-origin HTML5 localStorage key/value data that Safari persists as localstorage.sqlite3 under the WebKit container, for the default profile and for each named profile. Each row is one stored key and its decoded value, attributed to its storage origin and the top-level partition origin from the companion origin file. Because a web application can retain tokens, identifiers, and application state here independently of browsing history, this data can reveal site usage and third-party tracking relationships that survive history clearing.

macOS.name: Safari Preferences
macOS.description: Safari Preferences contains important Safari browser settings.

macOS.name: Safari Private Click Measurement
macOS.description: Safari Private Click Measurement contains ad-click attribution records, recovered from the WebKit pcm.db. Each entry records an advertisement the user clicked on a source site that led to a destination site, along with the click time. Attributed entries also recorded a conversion; unattributed entries recorded only the click.

macOS.name: Safari Profiles
macOS.description: Safari Profiles contains the list of Safari profiles, recovered from the SafariTabs.db database. It maps each profile's identifier (DefaultProfile or a UUID) to the name shown to the user, which allows per-profile data such as history and website data to be attributed to a named profile.

macOS.name: Safari Reading List
macOS.description: Safari Reading List contains items saved by the user for later reading. Items are recovered from the com.apple.ReadingList folder within the Safari Bookmarks.plist file.

macOS.name: Safari Recent Search Terms
macOS.description: Safari Recent Search Terms contains the search terms that a user runs in the Safari browser address bar (Smart Search field). Recovered from the RecentWebSearches key of com.apple.Safari.plist.

macOS.name: Safari Recently Closed Tabs
macOS.description: Safary Recently Closed Tabs contains a history of recently closed tabs in the Safari browser.

macOS.name: Safari Top Sites
macOS.description: Safari is a web browser developed by Apple. Safari is installed by default on all Mac computers and is available for windows. This table captures information related to the user's top sites.

macOS.name: Safari Website Preferences
macOS.description: Safari Website Preferences contains important Safari browser settings that are configured on a site by site basis. Some of the preferences include allowing automatic downloads, sharing the user's location with the website, and receiving notifications. The user's preferences are saved by Safari to PerSitePreferences.db.

macOS.name: WebKit Browser Session/Tabs (Carved)
macOS.description: WebKit Browser Sessions/Tabs contains information about the browser sessions and tabs that the user has open, while using a browser built with WebKit. Some examples of browsers that use WebKit are Chrome, Opera, and 360 Safe Browser. This artifact consolidates the existing Chrome, Safe Browser, and Opera equivalents in a single artifact. The usage of other browsers, such as Firefox and Safari, aren't likely to appear under this artifact.

macOS.name: WebKit Browser Web History (Carved)
macOS.description: WebKit Browser Web History contains information about the websites that a user visits while using a browser built with WebKit. Some examples of browsers that use WebKit are Chrome, Opera, and 360 Safe Browser. This artifact consolidates the existing Chrome, Safe Browser, and Opera equivalents in a single artifact. The usage of other browsers aren't likely to appear under this artifact, however, some URLs found by other browsers may also be found by this artifact.

macOS.name: YARA Rule Matches
macOS.description: The YARA artifact contains information about files and processes that matched with conditions specified in a YARA rule.

Refined Results.name: Potential Facebook Pictures
Refined Results.description: Potential Facebook Pictures contains any cached pictures that are recovered that potentially originate from Facebook.

Refined Results.name: Classifieds URLs
Refined Results.description: Classifieds URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with classifieds websites.

Refined Results.name: Cloud Passwords and Tokens
Refined Results.description: Cloud Passwords and Tokens contains cloud passwords and tokens that are found on the system. These accounts and their corresponding tokens can be used to acquire more evidence from the cloud.

Refined Results.name: Cloud Service URLs
Refined Results.description: Cloud Service URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with cloud service websites.

Refined Results.name: Dating Sites URLs
Refined Results.description: Dating Sites URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with dating websites.

Refined Results.name: Decrypted Database Files
Refined Results.description: Decrypted Database Files contains copies of decrypted database files produced as part of processing. Decrypted files (DB and support files) are stored in a ZIP package following the original source file path of the encrypted database file.

Refined Results.name: Email Attachments
Refined Results.description: Email Attachments contains any information about email attachments that have been discovered within other recovered artifacts.

Refined Results.name: Email Image Attachments
Refined Results.description: Email Image Attachments contains information about image attachments discovered within recovered email artifacts, including extracted Exif metadata.

Refined Results.name: Facebook URLs
Refined Results.description: Facebook URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with Facebook websites.

Refined Results.name: Generative AI Media
Refined Results.description: Generative AI Media encapsulates a list of media identified as having been manipulated or generated by an Artificial Intelligence (AI) feature.

Refined Results.name: Google Searches
Refined Results.description: Google Searches contains all of the URLs that are associated with the Google search engine.

Refined Results.name: Google Translate
Refined Results.description: Google Translate contains all of the translations done using google translate.

Refined Results.name: Human Trafficking Site URLs
Refined Results.description: Human Trafficking Site URLs identifies any URLs that link to escort services that are associated with human trafficking operations. Many classified advertisement sites also provide escort services, but the primary purpose of the sites in this list are providing escort services that are tied to human trafficking operations.

Refined Results.name: Identifiers
Refined Results.description: Identifiers contains all of the IDs of the people that are found on the system.

Refined Results.name: Identifiers - Device
Refined Results.description: Identifiers - Device contains all of the IDs of the unique devices that are found on the system.

Refined Results.name: Identifiers - People
Refined Results.description: Identifiers - People contains all of the IDs of the people that are found on the system.

Refined Results.name: Locally Accessed Files and Folders
Refined Results.description: Locally Access Files and Folders is a refined result that contains information about local and network resources that have been accessed by the user.

Refined Results.name: Parsed Search Queries
Refined Results.description: Parsed Search Queries contains all of the URLs that are associated with search engines, except for Google.

Refined Results.name: Passwords and Tokens
Refined Results.description: Passwords and Tokens is a refined result that collects passwords and tokens that are associated with user accounts. This refined results only applies to accounts that are recovered from mobile and computer sources. For accounts that are recovered from cloud sources, see Cloud Passwords and Tokens.

Refined Results.name: Potentially Unwanted Apps
Refined Results.description: Potentially Unwanted Apps contains records of applications that are believed to be potentially unwanted, such as spyware applications.

Refined Results.name: Shipping Site URLs
Refined Results.description: Shipping Site URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with shipping websites.

Refined Results.name: Social Media URLs
Refined Results.description: Social Media URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with social media websites.

Refined Results.name: Tax Site URLs
Refined Results.description: Tax Site URLs contains all of the URLs that are from a list of websites approved by IRS tax forms.

Refined Results.name: Tor URLs
Refined Results.description: Tor URLs identifies any .onion sites that were accessed via Tor or Tor proxy.

Refined Results.name: Torrent URLs
Refined Results.description: Torrent URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with torrent websites.

Refined Results.name: User Accounts
Refined Results.description: User Accounts contains all of the local user's application accounts that are found on the system.

Refined Results.name: Web Chat URLs
Refined Results.description: Web Chat URLs contains all of the URLs that are associated with web chat websites.
